title: Ramayana · Aranya Kanda
source: svenkatreddy/Ramayana_Book (Wikisource Sanskrit); Devanagari to IAST via sanscript

verses.transliteration: praviśya tu mahāraṇyam daṇḍakāraṇyam ātmavān .rāmo dadarśa durdharṣa tāpasa āśrama maṇḍalam ..3-1-1..
kuśa cīra parikṣiptam brāhmyā lakṣmyā samāvṛtam .yathā pradīptam durdarśam gagane sūrya maṇḍalam ..3-1-2..
śaraṇyam sarva bhūtānām su saṃmṛṣṭa ajiram sadā .mṛgaiḥ bahubhiḥ ākīrṇam pakṣi sanghaiḥ samāvṛtam ..3-1-3..
pūjitam ca upanṛttam ca nityam apsarasām gaṇaiḥ .viśālaiḥ agni śaraṇaiḥ sruk bhāṇḍaiḥ ajinaiḥ kuśaiḥ ..3-1-4..
samidbhiḥ toya kalaśaiḥ phala mūlaiḥ ca śobhitam .āraṇyaiḥ ca mahā vṛkṣaiḥ puṇyaiḥ svādu phalair vṛtam ..3-1-5..
bali homa arcitam puṇyam brahma ghoṣa nināditam .puṣpaiḥ ca anyaiḥ parikṣiptam padminyā ca sa padmayā ..3-1-6..
phalamūla aśanaiḥ dāntaiḥ cīra kṛṣṇājina ambaraiḥ .sūrya vaiśvānara ābhaiḥ ca purāṇaiḥ munibhir yutam ..3-1-7..
puṇyaiḥ ca niyata āhāraiḥ śobhitam parama ṛṣibhiḥ .tat brahma bhavana prakhyam brahma ghoṣa nināditam ..3-1-8..
brahma vidbhiḥ mahā bhāgaiḥ brāhmaṇaiḥ upaśobhitam .tat dṛṣṭvā rāghavaḥ śrīmān tāpasa āśrama maṇḍalam ..3-1-9..
abhyagacchat mahātejā vijyam kṛtvā mahad dhanuḥ .divya jñāna upapannāḥ te rāmam dṛṣṭvā maharṣayaḥ ..3-1-10..
abhijagmuḥ tadā prītā vaidehīm ca yaśasvinīm .te tu somam iva udyantam dṛṣṭvā vai dharmacāriṇam ..3-1-11..
lakṣmaṇam ca eva dṛṣṭvā tu vaidehīm ca yaśaśvinīm .maṅgalāni prayuñjānāḥ pratyagṛhṇān dṛḍha vratāḥ ..3-1-12..
rūpa saṃhananam lakṣmīm saukumāryam suveṣatām .dadṛśur vismita ākārā rāmasya vana vāsinaḥ ..3-1-13..
vaidehīm lakṣmaṇam rāmam netrair animiṣair iva .āścarya bhūtān dadṛśuḥ sarve te vana vāsinaḥ ..3-1-14..
atra enam hi mahābhāgāḥ sarva bhūta hite ratāḥ .atithim parṇaśālāyām rāghavam saṃnyaveśayan ..3-1-15..
tato rāmasya satkṛtya vidhinā pāvaka upamāḥ .ājahruḥ te mahābhāgāḥ salilam dharmacāriṇaḥ ..3-1-16..
maṃgalāni prayuñjānā mudā paramayā yutā .mūlam puṣpam phalam sarvam āśramam ca mahātmanaḥ ..3-1-17..
nivedayītvā dharmajñāḥ te tu prāṃjalayo'bruvan .dharmapālo janasya asya śaraṇyaḥ ca mahāyaśāḥ ..3-1-18..
pūjanīyaḥ ca mānyaḥ ca rājā daṇḍadharo guruḥ .indrasya eva caturbhāgaḥ prajā rakṣati rāghava ..3-1-19..
rājā tasmād varān bhogān ramyān bhuṅkte namaskṛtaḥ .te vayam bhavatā rakṣyā bhavad viṣaya vāsinaḥ .nagarastho vanastho vā tvam naḥ rājā janeśvaraḥ ..3-1-20..
nyasta daṇḍā vayam rājan jita krodhā jitendriyāḥ .rakṣaṇīyāḥ tvayā śaśvad garbha bhūtāḥ tapodhanāḥ ..3-1-21..
evam uktvā phalair mūlaiḥ puṣpair anyaiḥ ca rāghavam .vanyaiḥ ca vividha āhāraiḥ sa lakṣmaṇam apūjayan ..3-1-22..
tathā'nye tāpasāḥ siddhā rāmam vaiśvānara upamāḥ .nyāya vṛttā yathā nyāyam tarpayāmāsur īśvaram ..3-1-23..
kṛta ātithyo'tha rāmastu sūryasya udayanam prati .āmaṃtrya sa munīm tat sarvān vanam eva anvagāhata ..3-2-1..
nānā mṛga gaṇa ākīrṇam ṛkṣa śārdūla sevitam .dhvasta vṛkṣa latā gulmam durdarśa salilāśayam ..3-2-2..
niṣkūjamānā śakuni jhillikā gaṇa nāditam .lakṣmaṇa anucaroo rāmo vana madhyam dadarśa ha ..3-2-3..
sītāyā saha kākutsthaḥ tasmin ghora mṛga āyute .dadarśa giri śṛṅga ābham puruṣādam mahāsvanam ..3-2-4..
gambhīra akṣam mahāvaktram vikaṭam vikaṭodaram .bībhatsam viṣamam dīrgham vikṛtam ghora darśanam ..3-2-5..
vasānam carma  vaiyāghram vasa ārdram rudhirokṣitam .trāsanam sarva bhūtānām vyāditāsyam iva antakam ..3-2-6..
trīn siṃhān caturo vyāghrān dvau vṛkau pṛṣatān daśa .saviṣāṇam vasādigdham gajasya ca śiro mahat ..3-2-7..
avasajya āayase śūle vinadantam mahāsvanam .sa rāmam lakṣmaṇam caiva sītām dṛṣṭvā ca maithilīm ..3-2-8..
abhya dhāvat susaṃkruddho prajāḥ kāla iva antakaḥ .sa kṛtvā bhairavam nādam cālayan iva medinīm ..3-2-9..
aṅkena ādāya vaidehīm apakramya tadā abravīt .yuvām jaṭā cīra dharau sabhāryau kṣīṇa jīvitau ..3-2-10..
praviṣṭau daṇḍakāraṇyam śara cāpa asi pāṇinau .katham tāpasayoḥ yuvām ca vāsaḥ pramadayā saha ..3-2-11..
adharma cāriṇau pāpau kau yuvām muni dūṣakau .aham vanam idam durgam virāgho nāma rākṣasaḥ ..3-2-12..
carāmi sāyudho nityam ṛṣi māṃsāni bhakṣayan .iyam nārī varārohā mama bhāryā bhaviṣyati ..3-2-13..
yuvayoḥ pāpayoḥ ca aham pāsyāmi rudhiram mṛdhe .tasya evam bruvato duṣṭam virādhasya durātmanaḥ ..3-2-14..
śrutvā sagarvitam vākyam saṃbhrāntā janakātmajā .sītā prāvepitā udvegāt pravāte kadalī yathā ..3-2-15..
tām dṛṣṭvā rāghavaḥ sītām virādha aṅkagatām śubhām .abravīt lakṣmaṇam vākyam mukhena pariśuṣyatā ..3-2-16..
paśya saumya narendrasya janakasya atma saṃbhavām .mama bhāryām śubhācārām virādhāṅke praveśitām ..3-2-17..
atyanta sukha saṃvṛddhām rājaputrīm yaśasvinīm .yat abhipretam asmāsu priyam vara vṛtam ca yat ..3-2-18..
kaikeyyāstu susaṃvṛttam kṣipram adya eva lakṣmaṇa .yā na tuṣyati rājyena putrārthe dīrgha darśinī ..3-2-19..
yayā'ham sarvabhūtānām priyaḥ prasthāpito vanam .adya idānīm sakāmā sā yā mātā mama madhyamā ..3-2-20..
para sparśāt tu vaidehyā na duḥkhataram asti me .pitur vināśāt saumitre sva rājya haraṇāt tathā ..3-2-21..
iti bruvati kākutsthe bāṣpa śoka pariplutaḥ .abravīt lakṣmaṇaḥ kruddho ruddho nāga iva śvasan ..3-2-22..
anātha iva bhūtānām nāthaḥ tvam vāsavopamaḥ .mayā preṣyeṇa kākutsthaḥ kim artham paritapyase ..3-2-23..
śareṇa nihatasya adya mayā kruddhena rakṣasaḥ .virādhasya gata asoḥ hi mahī pāsyati śoṇitam ..3-2-24..
rājya kāme mama krodho bharate yo babhūva ha .tam virādhe vimokṣyāmi vajrī vajram iva acale ..3-2-25..
mama bhuja bala vega vegitaḥpatatu śaro'sya mahān mahorasi .vyapanayatu tanoḥ ca jīvitampatatu tataḥ ca mahīm vighūrṇitaḥ ..3-2-26..
atha uvāca punar vākyam virādhaḥ pūrayan vanam .pṛcchato mama hi brūtam kau yuvām kva gamiṣyathaḥ ..3-3-1..
tam uvāca tato rāmo rākṣasam jvalita ānanam .pṛcchantam sumahātejā ikṣvāku kulam ātmanaḥ ..3-3-2..
kṣatriyau vṛtta saṃpannau viddhi nau vanagocarau .tvām tu veditum icchāvaḥ kaḥ tvam carasi daṇḍakān ..3-3-3..
tam uvāca virādhaḥ tu rāmam satya parākramam .hanta vakṣyāmi te rājan nibodha mama rāghava ..3-3-4..
putraḥ kila javasya aham mātā mama  śatahradā .virādha iti mām āhuḥ pṛthivyām sarva rākṣasāḥ ..3-3-5..
tapasā ca abhi saṃprāptā brahmaṇo hi prasādajā .śastreṇa avadhyatā loke acchedya abhedyatvam eva ca ..3-3-6..
utsṛjya pramadām enām anapekṣau yathā āgatam .tvaramāṇau palāyethām na vām jīvitam ādade ..3-3-7..
tam rāmaḥ prati uvāca idam kopa saṃrakta locanaḥ .rākṣasam vikṛta ākāram virādham pāpa cetasam ..3-3-8..
kṣudra dhiktvām tu hīnārtham mṛtyum anveṣase dhruvam .raṇe prāpsyasi saṃtiṣṭha na me jīvan vimokṣyase ..3-3-9..
tataḥ sajyam dhanuḥ kṛtvā rāmaḥ suniśitān śarān .su śīghram abhisaṃdhāya rākṣasam nijaghāna ha ..3-3-10..
dhanuṣā jyā guṇavatā sapta bāṇān mumoca ha .rukma puṃkhān mahāvegān suparṇa anila tulya gān ..3-3-11..
te śarīram virādhasya bhittvā barhiṇa vāsasaḥ .nipetuḥ śoṇitā digdhā dharaṇyām pāvakopamāḥ ..3-3-12..
sa viddho nyasya vaidehīm śūlam udyamya rākṣasaḥ .abhyadravat susaṃkruddhaḥ tadā rāmam sa lakṣmaṇam  ..3-3-13..
sa vinadya mahānādam śūlam śakra dhvaja upamam .pragṛhya aśobhata tadā vyāttānana iva aṃtakaḥ ..3-3-14..
atha tau bhrātarau dīptam śara varṣam vavarṣatuḥ .virādhe rākṣase tasmin kālāṃtaka ayam upame ..3-3-15..
sa prahasya mahā raudraḥ sthitvā ajṛmbhata rākṣasaḥ .jṛṃbhamāṇasya te bāṇāḥ kāyāt niṣpetur aśugāḥ ..3-3-16..
sparśāt tu vara dānena prāṇān saṃrodhya rākṣasaḥ .virādhaḥ śūlam udyamya rāghavau abhyadhāvata  ..3-3-17..
tat śūlam vajra saṃkāśam gagane jvalana upamam .dvābhyām śarābhyām ciccheda rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtām varaḥ ..3-3-18..
tat rāma viśikhaiḥ chinnam śūlam tasya āpatat bhuviḥ .papāta aśaninā cinnam meror iva śilā talam  ..3-3-19..
tau khaḍgau kṣipram udyamya kṛṣṇa sarpau iva udyatau .tūrṇam āpetatuḥ tasya tadā prahāratām balāt  ..3-3-20..
sa vadhyamāna subhṛśam bhujābhyām parigṛhya tau  .aprakaṃpyau naravyāghrau raudraḥ prasthātum aicchata  ..3-3-21..
tasya abhiprāyam ajñāya rāmo lakṣmaṇam abravīt  .vahatu ayam alam tāvat pathānena tu rākṣasaḥ  ..3-3-22..
yathā ca icchati soumitre tathā vahatu rākṣasaḥ  .ayam eva hi naḥ panthā yena yāti niśācaraḥ  ..3-3-23..
sa tu sva bala vīryeṇa samutkṣipya niśācaraḥ .bālāḥ iva skandha gatau cakāra ati baloddhataḥ  ..3-3-24..
tau āropya tataḥ skandham rāghavo  rajanī caraḥ  .virādho vinadan ghoram jagāma abhimukho vanam  ..3-3-25..
vanam mahā megha nibham praviṣṭodrumaiḥ mahadbhiḥ vividhaiḥ upetam .nānā vidhaiḥ pakṣi kulaiḥ vicitramśiva āyutam vyāla mṛgaiḥ vikīrṇam  ..3-3-26..
hriyamāṇau tu kākutsthau dṛṣṭvā sītā raghūttamau  .uccaiḥ svareṇa cukrośa pragṛhya su mahābhujau  ..3-4-1..
eṣa dāśarathī rāmaḥ satyavān śīlavān śuciḥ  .rakṣasā raudra rūpeṇa hriyate saha lakṣmaṇaḥ  ..3-4-2..
mām ṛkā bhakṣa iṣyanti śārdūla dvīpinaḥ tathā .mām haraḥ utsṛjya kākutsthau namaste rākṣasottamaḥ ..3-4-3..
tasyāḥ tat vacanam śrutvā vaidehyāḥ rāma lakṣmaṇau .vegam pracakratur vīrau vadhe tasya durātmanaḥ ..3-4-4..
tasya raudrasya soumitriḥ savyam bāhum babhañja ha  .rāmaḥ tu dakṣiṇam bāhum tarasā tasya rakṣasaḥ  ..3-4-5..
saḥ bhagna bahuḥ saṃvignaḥ papāta āśu vimūrchitaḥ  .dharaṇyām megha saṃkāśo vajra bhinna iva acalaḥ  ..3-4-6..
muṣṭibhir bāhubhir padbhiḥ sūdayantau tu rākṣasam .udyamyodyamya ca api enam sthaṇḍile niṣpipeṣatuḥ ..3-4-7..
sa viddho bahubhir bāṇaiḥ khaḍgābhyām ca parikṣataḥ .niṣpiṣṭo bahudhā bhūmau na mamāra sa rākṣasaḥ ..3-4-8..
tam prekṣya rāmaḥ subhṛśam avadhyam acala upamam .bhayeṣu abhaya daḥ śrīmān idam vacanam abravīt  ..3-4-9..
tapasā puruṣavyāghra rākṣaso'yam na śakyate .śastreṇa yudhi nirjetum rākṣasam nikhanāvahe ..3-4-10..
kuṃjarsya iva raudrasya rākṣasasya asya lakṣmaṇa! .vane asmin sumahad śvabhram khanyatām raudravarcasaḥ ..3-4-11..
iti uktvā lakṣmaṇam rāmaḥ pradaraḥ khanyatām iti .tasthau virādham ākrmya kaṇṭhe pādena vīryavān  ..3-4-12..
tat śrutvā rāghaveṇa uktam rākṣasaḥ praśritam vacaḥ .idam provāca kākutstham virādhaḥ puruṣarṣabham ..3-4-13..
hato'ham puruṣavyāghraḥ śakra tulya balena vai .mayā tu pūrvam tvam mohān na jñātaḥ puruṣarṣabhaḥ ..3-4-14..
kausalyā suprajātaḥ tāta rāmaḥ tvam vidito mayā  .vaidehī ca mahābhāgā lakṣmaṇaḥ ca mahāyaśāḥ  ..3-4-15..
abhi śāpād aham ghoram praviṣṭo rākṣsīm tanum  .tuṃburuḥ nāma gandharvaḥ śapto vaiśravaṇena hi  ..3-4-16..
prasādyamānaḥ ca mayā so'bravīt mām mahāyaśāḥ  .yadā dāśarathī ramaḥ tvām vadhiṣyati saṃyuge  ..3-4-17..
tadā prakṛtim āpanno bhavān svargam gamiṣyati .anupasthīyamāno mām sa kruddho vyājahāra ha  ..3-4-18..
iti vaiśravaṇo rājā raṃbha āsaktam uvāca ha .tava prasādān mukto aham abhiśāpāt su dāruṇāt  ..3-4-19..
bhuvanam svam gamiṣyāmi svasti vo'stu paraṃtapa .ito vasati dharmātmā śarabhaṅgaḥ pratāpavān ..3-4-20..
adhyartha yojane tātaḥ maharṣiḥ sūrya saṃnibhaḥ .tam kṣipram abhigaccha tvam sa te śreyo abhidhāsyati ..3-4-21..
avaṭe ca api mām rāma nikṣipya kuśalī vraja .rakṣasām gata sattvānām eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ  ..3-4-22..
avaṭe ye nidhīyante teṣām lokāḥ sanātanāḥ .evam uktvā tu kākutstham virādhaḥ śara pīḍitaḥ ..3-4-23..
babhūva svarga saṃprāpto nyasta deho mahābalaḥ .tat śrutvā rāghavaḥ vākyam lakṣmaṇam vyādideśa ha ..3-4-24..
kuṃjarsya iva raudrasya rākṣasasya asya lakṣmaṇa! .vane asmin sumahat śvabhram khanyatām raudrakarmaṇaḥ..3-4-25..
iti uktvā lakṣmaṇam rāmaḥ pradaraḥ khanyatām iti .tasthau virādham ākramya kaṇṭhe pādena vīryavān  ..3-4-26..
tataḥ khanitram ādāya lakṣmaṇaḥ śvabhram uttamam  .akhanat pārśvataḥ tasya virādhasya mahātmanaḥ ..3-4-27..
tam mukta kaṇṭham  utkṣipya śaṅku karṇam mahāsvanam .virādham prākṣipat śvabhre nadantam bhairava svanam ..3-4-28..
tam āhave dāruṇam āśu vikramausthirau ubhau saṃyati rāma lakṣmaṇau .mudānvitau cikṣipatur bhayāvahamnadantam utkṣipya bilena rākṣsam ..3-4-29..
avadhyatām prekṣya mahāsurasya tauśitena śastreṇa tadā nararṣabhau .samarthya ca atyartha viśāradau ubhaubile viradhasya vadham pracakratuḥ ..3-4-30..
svayam virādhena hi mṛtyum ātmanaḥprasahya rāmeṇa vadhārtham īpsitaḥ .niveditaḥ kānana cāriṇā svayamna me vadhaḥ śastra kṛto bhavet iti ..3-4-31..
tadeva rāmeṇa niśamya bhāṣitamkṛtā matiḥ tasya bila praveśane .bilam ca tena ati balena rakṣasāpraveśyamānena vanam vināditam ..3-4-32..
prahṛṣṭa rūpau iva rāma lakṣmaṇauvirādham urvyām pradare nipātya tam .nanandatuḥ vīta bhayau mahāvaneśilābhiḥ antar dadhatuḥ ca rākṣasam ..3-4-33..
tataḥ tu tau kāṃcana citra kārmukaunihatya rakṣaḥ parigṛhya maithilīm .vijahratuḥ tau muditau mahāvanedivi sthitau candra divākarau iva ..3-4-34..
hatvā tu tam bhīma balam virādham rākṣasam vane .tataḥ sītām pariṣvajya samāśvāsya ca vīryavān ..3-5-1..
abravīt bhrātaram rāmo lakṣmaṇam dīpta tejasam .kaṣṭam vanam idam durgam na ca smo vana gocarāḥ ..3-5-2..
abhigacchāmahe śīghram śarabhaṅgam tapo dhanam .āśramam śarabhangasya rāghavo'bhijagāma ha ..3-5-3..
tasya deva prabhāvasya tapasā bhāvita ātmanaḥ .samīpe śarabhaṃgasya dadarśa mahat adbhutam ..3-5-4..
vibhrājamānam vapuṣā sūrya vaiśvānara prabham .ratha pravaram ārūḍham ākāśe vibudha anugam ..3-5-5..
asaṃspṛśantam vasudhām dadarśa vibudha īśvaram .saṃprabha ābharaṇam devam virajo aṃbara dhāriṇam ..3-5-6..
tat vidhaiḥ eva bahubhir pūjyamānam mahātmabhiḥ .haritaiḥ vājibhir yuktam aṃtarikṣa gatam ratham ..3-5-7..
dadarśa adūrataḥ tasya taruṇa āditya saṃnibham .pāṇḍura abhra ghana prakhyam candra maṇḍala saṃnibham ..3-5-8..
apaśyat vimalam chatram citra mālya upaśobhitam .cāmara vyajane ca agrye rukma daṇḍe mahādhane ..3-5-9..
gṛhīte vara nārībhyām dhūyamāne ca mūrdhani .gandharva amara siddhāḥ ca bahavaḥ parama ṛṣayaḥ ..3-5-10..
antarikṣa gatam devam gīrbhir agryābhir aiḍiyan .saha saṃbhāṣamāṇe tu śarabhaṃgena vāsave ..3-5-11..
dṛṣṭvā śata kratum tatra rāmo lakṣmaṇam abravīt .rāmo'tha ratham uddiśya bhrātur darśayata adbhutam ..3-5-12..
arciṣmantam śriyā juṣṭam adbhutam paśya lakṣmaṇa .pratapantam iva ādityam antarikṣa gatam ratham ..3-5-13..
ye hayāḥ puru hūtasya purā śakrasya naḥ śrutāḥ .antarikṣa gatā divyāḥ te ime harayo dhruvam ..3-5-14..
ime ca puruṣa vyāghra ye tiṣṭhanti abhitaḥ diśam .śatam śatam kuṇḍalino yuvānaḥ khaḍga pāṇayaḥ ..3-5-15..
vistīrṇa vipula uraskāḥ parighāyata bāhavaḥ .śoṇāṃśu vasanāḥ sarve vyāghra iva durāsadāḥ ..3-5-16..
uro deśeṣu sarveṣām hārā jvalana saṃnibhāḥ .rūpam bibhrati saumitre paṃca viṃśati vārṣikam ..3-5-17..
etaddhi kila devānām vayo bhavati nityadā .yathā ime puruṣa vyāghrā dṛśyante priya darśanāḥ ..3-5-18..
iha eva saha vaidehyā muhūrtam tiṣṭha lakṣmaṇa .yāvat jānāmi aham vyaktam ka eṣa dyutimān rathe ..3-5-19..
tam evam uktvā saumitrim iha eva sthīyatām iti .abhicakrāma kākutsthaḥ śarabhaṃga āśramam prati ..3-5-20..
tataḥ samabhigacchantam prekṣya rāmam śacī patiḥ .śarabhaṃgam anujñāpya vibudhān idam abravīt ..3-5-21..
iha upayāti asau rāmo yāvan mām na abhibhāṣate .niṣṭhām nayata tāvat tu tato mā draṣṭum arhati ..3-5-22..
jitavantam kṛtārtham hi tadā aham acirād imam .karma hi anena kartavyam mahat anyaiḥ suduṣkaram ..3-5-23..
atha vajrī tam āmaṃtrya mānayitvā ca tāpasam .rathena haya yuktena yayau divam arindamaḥ ..3-5-24..
prayāte tu sahasrākṣe rāghavaḥ saparicchadaḥ .agni hotram upāsīnam śarabhaṃgam upāgamat ..3-5-25..
tasya pādau ca saṃgṛhya rāmaḥ sītā ca lakṣmaṇaḥ .niṣeduḥ tad anujñātā labdha vāsā nimaṃtritāḥ ..3-5-26..
tataḥ śakra upayānam tu paryapṛcchata rāghavaḥ .śarabhaṃgaḥ ca tat sarvam rāghavāya nyavedayat ..3-5-27..
mām eṣa varado rāma brahma lokam ninīṣati .jitam ugreṇa tapasā duṣprāpam akṛta ātmabhiḥ ..3-5-28..
aham jñātvā nara vyāghra vartamānam adūrataḥ .brahma lokam na gacchāmi tvām adṛṣṭvā priya atithim ..3-5-29..
tvayā aham puruṣavyāghra dhārmikeṇa mahatmanāa .samāgamya gamiṣyāmi tridivam ca avaram param ..3-5-30..
akṣayā nara śārdūla jitālokā mayā śubhāḥ .brāhmyāḥ ca nāka pṛṣṭhyāḥ ca pratigṛhṇīṣva māmakān ..3-5-31..
evam ukto naravyāghraḥ sarva śāstra viśāradaḥ .ṛṣiṇā śarabhaṃgena rāghavo vākyam abravīt ..3-5-32..
aham eva āhariṣyāmi sarvān lokān mahāmune .āvāsam tu aham icchāmi pradiṣṭam iha kānane ..3-5-33..
rāghaveṇa evam uktaḥ tu śakra tulya balena vai .śarabhaṃgo mahāprājñaḥ punar eva abravīt vacaḥ ..3-5-34..
iha rāma mahātejāḥ sutīkṣṇo nama dhārmikaḥ .vasati araṇye niyataḥ sa te śreyo vidhāsyati ..3-5-35..
sutīkṣṇam abhigaccha tvam śucau deśe tapasvinam .ramaṇīye vanoddeśe sa te vāsam vidhāsyati ..3-5-36..
imām mandākinīm rāma pratisrotam anuvraja .nadīm puṣpoḍupa vahām tataḥ tatra gamiṣyasi ..3-5-37..
eṣa panthā naravyāghra muhūrtam paśya tāta mām .yāvat jahāmi gātrāṇi jīrṇām tvacam iva uragaḥ ..3-5-38..
tato agnim su samādhāya hutvā ca ājyena maṃtravit .śarabhaṃgo mahātejāḥ praviveśa hutāśanam ..3-5-39..
tasya romāṇi keśām ca tadā vahniḥ mahātmanaḥ .jīrṇam tvacam tad asthīni yat ca māṃsam ca śoṇitam ..3-5-40..
sa ca pāvaka saṃkāśaḥ kumāraḥ samapadyata .utthāya agnicayāt tasmāt śarabhaṃgo vyarocata ..3-5-41..
sa lokān āhitāgnīnām ṛṣīṇām ca mahātmanām .devānām ca vyatikramya brahma lokam vyarohata ..3-5-42..
sa puṇya karmā bhuvane dvijarṣabhaḥpitāmaham sānucaram dadarśa ha .pitāmahaḥ ca api samīkṣya tam dvijamnananda susvāgatam iti uvāca ha  ..3-5-43..
śarabhaṅge divam prāpte muni saṃghāḥ samāgatāḥ .abhyagacchanta kākutstham rāmam jvalita tejasam  ..3-6-1..
vaikhānasā vālakhilyāḥ saṃprakṣālā marīcipāḥ .aśma kuṭṭāḥ ca bahavaḥ patra āhārāḥ ca tāpasāḥ ..3-6-2..
danta ulūkhalinaḥ ca eva tathā eva unmajjakāḥ pare .gātra śayyā aśayyāḥ ca tathā eva anavakāśikāḥ ..3-6-3..
munayaḥ salila āhārā vāyu bhakṣāḥ tathā apare .ākāśa nilayāḥ ca eva tathā sthaṇḍila śāyinaḥ  ..3-6-4..
tathā ūrthva vāsinaḥ dāntāḥ tathā ārdra paṭa vāsasaḥ .sa japāḥ ca tapo nityāḥ tathā paṃca tapo'nvitāḥ ..3-6-5..
sarve brāhmyā śriyā jyuktā dṛḍha yoga samāhitāḥ .śarabhaṃga āśrame rāmam abhijagmuḥ ca tāpasāḥ  ..3-6-6..
abhigamya ca dharmajñā rāmam dharma bhṛtām varam .ūcuḥ parama dharmajñam ṛṣi saṃghāḥ samāgatāḥ ..3-6-7..
tvam ikṣvāku kulasya asya pṛthivyāḥ ca mahārathaḥ .pradhānaḥ ca api nāthaḥ ca devānām maghavān iva ..3-6-8..
viśrutaḥ triṣu lokeṣu yaśasā vikrameṇa ca .pitṛ vratatvam satyam ca tvayi dharmaḥ ca puṣkalaḥ ..3-6-9..
tvām āsādya mahātmānam dharmajñam dharma vatsalam .arthitvāt nātha vakṣyāmaḥ tat ca naḥ kṣantum arhasi ..3-6-10..
adhārmaḥ sumahān nātha bhavet tasya tu bhūpateḥ .yo haret bali ṣaḍ bhāgam na ca rakṣati putravat ..3-6-11..
yuṃjānaḥ svān iva prāṇān prāṇaiḥ iṣṭān sutān iva .nitya yuktaḥ sadā rakṣan sarvān viṣaya vāsinaḥ ..3-6-12..
prāpnoti śāśvatīm rāma kīrtim sa bahu vārṣikīm .brahmaṇaḥ sthānam āsādya tatra ca api mahīyate ..3-6-13..
yat karoti param dharmam muniḥ mūla phala aśanaḥ .tatra rājñaḥ catur bhāgaḥ prajā dharmeṇa rakṣataḥ ..3-6-14..
so ayam brāhmaṇa bhūyiṣṭho vānaprastha gaṇo mahān .tvam nātho anāthavat rāma rākṣasaiḥ hanyate bhṛśam ..3-6-15..
ehi paśya śarīrāṇi munīnām bhāvita ātmanām .hatānām rākṣasaiḥ ghoraiḥ bahūnām bahudhā vane ..3-6-16..
paṃpā nadī nivāsānām anumandākinīm api .citrakūṭa ālayānām ca kriyate kadanam mahat ..3-6-17..
evam vayam na mṛṣyāmo viprakāram tapasvinām .kriyamāṇam vane ghoram rakṣobhiḥ bhīma karmabhiḥ ..3-6-18..
tataḥ tvām śaraṇārtham ca śaraṇyam samupasthitāḥ .paripālaya naḥ rāma vadhyamānān niśācaraiḥ ..3-6-19..
parā tvattaḥ gatiḥ vīra pṛdhivyam na upapadyate .paripālaya naḥ sarvān rākṣasebhyo nṛpātmajaḥ ..3-6-20..
etat śrutvā tu kākutsthaḥ tāpasānām tapasvinām .idam provāca dharmātmā sarvān eva tapasvinaḥ ..3-6-21..
na evam arhatha mām vaktum ājñāpyaḥ aham tapasvinām .kevalena sva kāryeṇa praveṣṭavyam vanam mayā  ..3-6-22..
viprakāram apākraṣṭum rākṣasaiḥ bhavatām imam .pituḥ tu nirdeśakaraḥ  praviṣṭo aham idam vanam ..3-6-23..
bhavatām artha siddhyartham āgato'ham yadṛcchayā .tasya me ayam vane vāso bhaviṣyati mahāphalaḥ  ..3-6-24..
tapasvinām raṇe śatrūn hantum icchāmi rākṣasān .paśyantu vīryam ṛṣayaḥ saḥ brātur me tapodhanāḥ ..3-6-25..
dattvā abhayam ca api tapo dhanānāmdharme dhṛita ātmā saha lakṣmaṇena .tapo dhanaiḥ ca api saha ārya dattaḥsutīkṣṇam eva abhijagāma vīraḥ ..3-6-26..
rāmaḥ tu sahitaḥ bhrātrā sītayā ca paraṃtapaḥ .sutīkṣṇasya āśrama padam jagāma saha taiḥ dvijaiḥ ..3-7-1..
rāmaḥ tu sahitaḥ bhrātrā sītayā ca paraṃtapaḥ .sutīkṣṇasya āśrama padam jagāma saha taiḥ dvijaiḥ ..3-7-1..
sa gatvā dīrgham adhvānam nadīḥ tīrtvā bahu udakāḥ .dadarśa vimalam śailam mahā merum iva unnatam ..3-7-2..
tataḥ tad ikṣvāku varau satatam vividhaiḥ drumaiḥ .kānanam tau viviśatuḥ sītayā saha rāghavau ..3-7-3..
praviṣṭaḥ tu vanam ghoram bahu puṣpa phala drumam .dadarśa āśramam ekānte cīra mālā pariṣkṛtam ..3-7-4..
tatra tāpasam āsīnam mala paṅkaja  dhāriṇam .rāmaḥ sutīkṣṇam vidhivat tapodhanam abhāṣata  ..3-7-5..
rāmo'ham asmi bhagavan bhavantam draṣṭum āgataḥ .tat mā abhivada dharmajña maharṣe satya vikrama ..3-7-6..
sa nirīkṣya tataḥ dhīro rāmam dharmabhṛtām varam .samāśliṣya ca bāhubhyām idam vacanam abravīt  ..3-7-7..
svāgatam te raghu śreṣṭha rāma satyabhṛtām vara .āśramao ayam tvayā ākrāntaḥ sanātha iva sāṃpratam ..3-7-8..
pratīkṣamāṇaḥ tvām eva na ārohe aham mahāyaśaḥ .deva lokam ito vīra deham tyaktvā mahītale ..3-7-9..
citrakūṭam upādāya rājya bhraṣṭo asi me  śrutaḥ .iha upayātaḥ kākutsthaḥ devarājaḥ śatatakratuḥ  ..3-7-10..
upāgamya ca me devo mahādevaḥ sura īśvaraḥ .sarvān lokān jitān āha mama puṇyena karmaṇā ..3-7-11..
teṣu deva ṛṣi juṣṭeṣu jiteśu tapasā mayā  .mat prasādāt sa bhāryaḥ tvam viharasva sa lakṣmaṇaḥ ..3-7-12..
tam ugra tapasam dīptam maharṣim satya vādinam .pratyuvāca ātmavān rāmo brahmāṇam iva vāsavaḥ ..3-7-13..
aham eva āhariṣyāmi svayam lokān mahāmune .āvāsam tu aham icchāmi pradiṣṭam iha kānane ..3-7-14..
bhavān sarvatra kuśalaḥ sarvabhūta hite rataḥ .ākhyātaḥ śarabhaṃgena gautamena mahātmanā ..3-7-15..
evam uktaḥ tu rāmeṇa maharṣiḥ loka viśrutaḥ .abravīt madhuram vākyam harṣeṇa mahatā yutaḥ ..3-7-16..
ayam eva āśramo rāma guṇavān ramyatām iti .ṛṣi saṃgha anucaritaḥ sadā mūla phalair yutaḥ ..3-7-17..
imam āśramam āgamya mṛga saṃghā mahīyasaḥ .ahatvā pratigacchanti lobhayitvā akutobhayāḥ ..3-7-18..
nā anyo doṣo bhavet atra mṛgebhyaḥ anyatra viddhi vai .tat  śrutvā vacanam tasya maharṣeḥ lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ ..3-7-19..
uvāca vacanam dhīro vigṛhya sa śaram dhanuḥ .tān aham sumahābhāga mṛgasaṃghān samāgatān ..3-7-20..
hanyām niśita dhāreṇa  śareṇa nata parvaṇā .bhavān tatra abhiṣajyeta kim syāt kṛcchra taram tataḥ ..3-7-21..
etasmin āśrame vāsam ciram tu na samarthaye .tam evam uktvā uparamam rāmaḥ saṃdhyām upāgamat ..3-7-22..
anvāsya paścimām saṃdhyām tatra vāsam akalpayat .sutīkṣṇasya āśrame ramye sītayā lakṣmanena ca ..3-7-23..
tataḥ  śubham tāpasa annamsvayam sutīkṣṇaḥ puruṣarṣabhābhyām .tābhyām susatkṛtya dadau mahātmāsaṃdhyā nivṛttau rajanīm samīkṣya ..3-7-24..
rāmaḥ tu saha saumitriḥ sutīkṣṇena abhipūjitaḥ .pariṇāmya niśām tatra prabhāte pratyabudhyata ..3-8-1..
utthāya ca yathā kālam rāghavaḥ saha sītayā .upaspṛśya su śītena toyena utpala gaṃdhinā ..3-8-2..
atha te agnim surām ca eva vaidehī rāma lakṣmaṇau .kālyam vidhivat abhyarcya tapasvi śaraṇe vane ..3-8-3..
udayantam dinakaram dṛṣṭvā vigata kalmaṣāḥ .sutīkṣṇam abhigamya idam ślakṣṇam vacanam abruvan ..3-8-4..
sukhoṣitāḥ sma bhagavan tvayā pūjyena pūjitāḥ .āpṛcchāmaḥ prayāsyāmo munayaḥ tvarayanti naḥ ..3-8-5..
tvarāmahe vayam draṣṭum kṛtsnam āśrama maṇḍalam .ṛṣīṇām puṇya śīlānām daṇḍakāraṇya vāsinām ..3-8-6..
abhyanujñātum icchāmaḥ saha ebhiḥ munipuṅgavaiḥ .dharma nityaiḥ tapo dāntaiḥ viśikhaiḥ iva pāvakaiḥ ..3-8-7..
aviṣahya ātapo yāvat sūryo na ati virājate .amārgeṇa āgatām lakṣmīm prāpya iva anvaya varjitaḥ ..3-8-8..
tāvat icchāmahe gantum iti uktvā caraṇau muneḥ .vavande saha saumitriḥ sītayā saha rāghavaḥ ..3-8-9..
tau sam spṛśaṃtau caraṇau utthāpya munipuṃgavaḥ .gāḍham āśliṣya sasneham idam vacanam abravīt ..3-8-10..
ariṣṭam gaccha panthānam rāma saumitriṇā saha .sītayā ca anayā sārdham chāya eva anuvṛttayā ..3-8-11..
paśya āśrama padam ramyam daṇḍakāraṇya vāsinām .eṣām tapasvinām vīra tapasā bhāvita ātmanām ..3-8-12..
suprājya phala mūlāni puṣpitāni vanāni ca .praśasta mṛga yūthāni śānta pakṣi gaṇāni ca ..3-8-13..
phulla paṃkaja khaṇḍāni prasanna salilāni ca .kāraṇḍava vikīrṇāni taṭākāni sarāṃsi ca ..3-8-14..
drakṣyase dṛṣṭi ramyāṇi giri prasravaṇāni ca  .ramaṇīyāni araṇyāni mayūra abhirutāni ca ..3-8-15..
gamyatām vatsa saumitre bhavān api ca gacchatu .āgantavyam ca te dṛṣṭvā punaḥ eva āśramam prati ..3-8-16..
evam uktaḥ tathā iti uktvā kākutsthaḥ saha lakṣmaṇaḥ .pradakṣiṇam munim kṛtvā prasthātum upacakrame ..3-8-17..
tataḥ śubhatare tūṇī dhanuṣī ca āyatekṣaṇā .dadau sītā tayoḥ bhrātroḥ khaḍgau ca vimalau tataḥ ..3-8-18..
ābadhya ca śubhe tūṇī cāpe ca ādāya sasvane .niṣkrāntau āśramāt gantum ubhau tau rāma lakṣmaṇau ..3-8-19..
śīghram tau rūpasaṃpannau anujñātau maharṣiṇā .prasthitau dhṛta cāpā asī sītayā saha rāghavau ..3-8-20..
sutīkṣṇena abhyanujñātam prasthitam raghu nandanam .hṛdyayā snigdhayā vācā bhartāram idam abravīt ..3-9-1..
adharmam tu susūkṣmeṇa vidhinā prāpyate mahān .nivṛttena ca śakyo ayam vyasanāt kāmajād iha ..3-9-2..
trīṇi eva vyasanāni atra kāmajāni bhavanti uta .mithyā vākyam tu paramam tasmāt gurutarā ubhau ..3-9-3..
para dāra abhigamanam vinā vairam ca raudratā .mithyā vākyam na te bhūtam na bhaviṣyati rāghava ..3-9-4..
kuto abhilaṣaṇam strīṇām pareṣām dharma nāśanam .tava nāsti manuṣyendra na ca ābhūt te kadācana ..3-9-5..
manasyapi tathā rāma na ca etat vidyate kvacit .sva dāra nirataḥ  ca eva nityam eva nṛpātmaja ..3-9-6..
dharmiṣṭaḥ satya sandhaḥ ca pituḥ nirdeśa kārakaḥ .tvayi dharmaḥ ca satyam ca tvayi sarvam pratiṣṭitam ..3-9-7..
tacca sarvam mahābāho śakyam voḍhum jiteindriyaiḥ .tava vaśya indriyatvam ca jānāmi śubhadarśana ..3-9-8..
tṛtīyam yad idam raudram para prāṇa abhihiṃsanam .nirvairam kriyate mohāt tat ca te samupasthitam ..3-9-9..
pratijñātaḥ tvayā vīra daṇḍakāraṇya vāsinām .ṛṣīṇām rakṣaṇārthāya vadhaḥ saṃyati rakṣasām ..3-9-10..
etan nimittam ca vanam daṇḍakā iti viśrutam .prasthitaḥ tvam saha bhrātrā dhṛta bāṇa śarāasanaḥ ..3-9-11..
tataḥ tvām prasthitam dṛṣṭvā mama cinta ākulam manaḥ .tvat vṛttam cintayantyā vai bhavet niḥśreyasam hitam ..3-9-12..
na hi me rocate vīraḥ gamanam daṇḍakān prati .kāraṇam tatra vakṣyāmi vadantyāḥ śrūyatām mama ..3-9-13..
tvam hi bāṇa dhanuṣpāṇiḥ bhrātrā saha vanam gataḥ .dṛṣṭvā vana carān sarvān kaccit kuryāḥ śara vyayam ..3-9-14..
kṣatriyāṇām iha dhanur hutāśasya indhanāni ca .samīpataḥ sthitam tejo balam ucchrayate bhṛśam ..3-9-15..
purā kila mahābāho tapasvī satya vāk śuciḥ .kasmin cit abhavat puṇye vane rata mṛga dvije ..3-9-16..
tasya eva tapaso vighnam kartum indraḥ śacīpatiḥ .khaḍga pāṇiḥ atha āgacchat āśramam bhaṭa rūpa dhṛk ..3-9-17..
tasmin tat āśrama pade nihitaḥ khaḍga uttamaḥ .sa nyāsa vidhinā dattaḥ puṇye tapasi tiṣṭhataḥ ..3-9-18..
sa tat śastram anuprāpya nyāsa rakṣaṇa tatparaḥ .vane tu vicarati eva rakṣan pratyayam ātmanaḥ ..3-9-19..
yatra gacchati upādātum mūlāni ca phalāni ca .na vinā yāti tam khaḍgam nyāsa rakṣaṇa tatparaḥ ..3-9-20..
nityam śastram parivahan krameṇa sa tapodhanaḥ .cakāra raudrīm svām buddhim tyaktvā tapasi niścayam ..3-9-21..
tataḥ sa raudra abhirataḥ pramatto adharma karṣitaḥ .tasya śastrasya saṃvāsāt jagāma narakam muniḥ ..3-9-22..
evam etat purā vṛttam śastra saṃyoga kāraṇam .agni saṃyogavat hetuḥ śastra saṃyoga ucyate ..3-9-23..
snehāt ca bahumānāt ca smāraye tvām na śikṣaye .na kathaṃcana sā kāryā gṛhīta dhanuṣā tvayā ..3-9-24..
buddhiḥ vairam vinā hantum rākṣasān daṇḍaka āśritān .aparādham vinā hantum loko vīra na kāmaye ..3-9-25..
kṣatriyāṇām tu vīrāṇām vaneṣu niyatātmanām .dhanuṣā kāryam etāvat ārtānām abhirakṣaṇam ..3-9-26..
kva ca śastram kva ca vanam kva ca kṣātram tapaḥ kva ca .vyāviddham idam asmābhiḥ deśa dharmaḥ tu pūjyatām ..3-9-27..
tadārya kaluṣā buddhiḥ jāyate śastra sevanāt .punar gatvāt tat ayodhyāyām kṣatra dharmam cariṣyasi ..3-9-28..
akṣayā tu bhavet prītiḥ śvaśrū śvaśurayoḥ mama .yadi rājyam hi saṃnyasya bhavet tvam nirato muniḥ ..3-9-29..
dharmāt arthaḥ prabhavati dharmāt prabhavate sukham .dharmeṇa labhate sarvam dharma sāram idam jagat ..3-9-30..
ātmānam niyamaiḥ taiḥ taiḥ karṣayitvā prayatnataḥ .prāpyate nipuṇaiḥ dharmo na sukhāt labhate sukham ..3-9-31..
nityam śuci matiḥ saumya cara dharmam tapo vane .sarvam hi viditam tubhyam trailokyam api tattvataḥ ..3-9-32..
strī cāpalāt etat udāhṛtam medharmam ca vaktum tava kaḥ samarthaḥ .vicārya buddhyā tu saha anujenayat rocate tat kuru ma acireṇa ..3-9-33..
vākyam etat tu vaidehyā vyāhṛtam bhartṛ bhaktyā .śrutvā dharme sthito rāmaḥ pratyuvāca jānakīm ..3-10-1..
hitam uktam tvayā devi snigdhayā sadṛśam vacaḥ .kulam vyapadiśantyā ca dharmajñe janaka ātmaje ..3-10-2..
kim nu vakṣyāmi aham devi tvayā eva uktam idam vacaḥ .kṣatriyaiḥ dhāryate cāpo na ārta śabdo bhaved iti ..3-10-3..
te ca ārtā daṇḍakāraṇye munayaḥ saṃśita vratāḥ .mām sīte svayam āgamya  śaraṇyāḥ  śaraṇam gatāḥ ..3-10-4..
vasantaḥ kāla kāleṣu vane mūla phala aśanāḥ .na labhante sukham bhīru rākṣasaiḥ krūra karmabhiḥ ..3-10-5..
bhakṣyante rākṣasaiḥ bhīmaiḥ nara māṃsopajīvibhiḥ .te bhakṣyamāṇā munayo daṇḍakāraṇya vāsinaḥ ..3-10-6..
asmān abhyavapadya iti mām ūcur dvija sattamāḥ .mayā tu vacanam  śrutvā teṣām evam mukhāt cyutam ..3-10-7..
kṛtvā vacana śuśruṣām vākyam etat udāhṛtam .prasīdantu bhavanto me hrīḥ eṣā tu mama atulā ..3-10-8..
yad īdṛśaiḥ aham vipraiḥ upastheyaiḥ upasthitaḥ .kim karomi iti ca mayā vyāhṛtam dvija saṃnidhau ..3-10-9..
sarvaiḥ eva samāgamya vāk iyam samudāhṛtā .rākṣasaiḥ daṇḍakāraṇye bahubhiḥ kāma rūpibhiḥ ..3-10-10..
arditāḥ sma bhṛśam rāma bhavān naḥ tatra rakṣatu .homa kāle tu saṃprāpte parva kāleṣu ca anagha ..3-10-11..
dharṣayanti sudurdharṣā rākṣasāḥ piśita aśanāḥ .rākṣasaiḥ dharṣitānām ca tāpasānām tapasvinām ..3-10-12..
gatim mṛgayamāṇānām bhavān naḥ paramā gatiḥ .kāmam tapaḥ prabhāveṇa  śaktā hantum niśācarān ..3-10-13..
cirārjitam na ca icchāmaḥ tapaḥ khaṇḍayitum vayam .bahu vighnam tapo nityam duḥścaram caiva rāghava ..3-10-14..
tena śāpam na muṃcāmo bhakṣyamāṇāḥ ca rākṣasaiḥ .tad ardyamānān rakṣobhiḥ daṇḍakāraṇya vāsibhiḥ ..3-10-15..
rakṣa naḥ tvam saha bhrātrā tvam nāthā hi vayam vane .mayā ca etat vacaḥ śrutvā kārtsnyena paripālanam ..3-10-16..
ṛṣīṇām daṇḍakāraṇye saṃśrutam janakāatmaje .saṃśrutya na ca śakṣyāmi jīvamānaḥ pratiśravam ..3-10-17..
munīnām anyathā kartum satyam iṣṭam hi me sadā .api aham jīvitam jahyām tvām vā sīte sa lakṣmaṇām ..3-10-18..
na tu pratijñām saṃśrutya brāhmaṇebhyo viśeṣataḥ .tat avaśyam mayā kāryam ṛṣīṇām paripālanam ..3-10-19..
anuktena api vaidehi pratijñāya katham punaḥ .mama snehāt ca sauhārdāt idam uktam tvayā vacaḥ ..3-10-20..
parituṣṭo asmi aham sīte na hi aniṣṭo anuśāsyate .sadṛśam ca anurūpam ca kulasya tava śobhane .sadharma cāriṇī me tvam prāṇebhyo api garīyasī ..3-10-21..
iti evam uktvā vacanam mahātmāsītām priyām maithila rāja putrīm .rāmo dhanuṣmān saha lakṣmaṇenajagāma ramyāṇi tapo vanāni ..3-10-22..
agrataḥ prayayau rāmaḥ sītā madhye suśobhanā .pṛṣṭhataḥ tu dhanuṣpāṇiḥ lakṣmaṇaḥ anujagāma ha ..3-11-1..
tau paśyamānau vividhān śaila prasthān vanāni ca .nadīḥ ca vividhā ramyā jagmatuḥ saha sītayā ..3-11-2..
sārasān cakravākāṃ ca nadī pulina cāriṇaḥ .sarāṃsi ca sapadmāni yutāni jalajaiḥ khagaiḥ ..3-11-3..
yūtha baddhām ca pṛṣatān mada unmattān viṣāṇinaḥ .mahiṣām ca varāhām ca gajām ca druma vairiṇaḥ ..3-11-4..
te gatvā dūram adhvānam laṃbamāne divākare .dadṛśuḥ sahitā raṃyam taṭākam yojana āyutam ..3-11-5..
padma puṣkara saṃbādham gaja yūthaiḥ alaṃkṛtam .sārasaiḥ haṃsa kādambaiḥ saṃkulam jala jātibhiḥ ..3-11-6..
prasanna salile ramye tasmin sarasi śuśruve .gīta vāditra nirghoṣo na tu kaścana dṛśyate ..3-11-7..
tataḥ kautūhalāt rāmo lakṣmaṇaḥ ca mahārathaḥ .munim dharmabhṛtam nāma praṣṭum samupacakrame ..3-11-8..
idam atyadbhutam śrutvā sarveṣām no mahāmune .kautūhalam mahat jātam kim idam sādhu kathyatām ..3-11-9..
tena evam ukto dharmātmā rāghaveṇa muniḥ tadā .prabhāvam sarasaḥ kṣipram ākhyātum upacakrame ..3-11-10..
idam paṃca apsaro nāma taṭākam sārva kālikam .nirmitam tapasā rāma muninā māṇḍakarṇinā ..3-11-11..
sa hi tepe tapaḥ tīvram māṇḍakarṇiḥ mahāmuniḥ .daśa varṣa sahasrāṇi vāyu bhakṣo jalāśaye ..3-11-12..
tataḥ pravyathitāḥ sarve devāḥ sa agni purogamāḥ .abruvan vacanam sarve paraspara samāgatāḥ ..3-11-13..
asmakam kasyacit sthānam eṣa prārthayate muniḥ .iti saṃvigna manasaḥ sarve tatra divaukasaḥ ..3-11-14..
tataḥ kartum tapo vighnam sarva devaiḥ niyojitāḥ .pradhāna apsarasaḥ paṃca vidyut calita varcasaḥ ..3-11-15..
apsarobhiḥ tataḥ tābhiḥ muniḥ dṛṣṭa parāvaraḥ .nīto madana vaśyatvam devānām kārya siddhaye ..3-11-16..
tāḥ caiva apsarasaḥ paṃca muneḥ patnītvam āgatāḥ .taṭāke nirmitam tāsām tasmin antarhitam gṛham ..3-11-17..
tatra eva apsarasaḥ paṃca nivasantyo yathā sukham .ramayanti tapoyogāt munim yauvanam āsthitam ..3-11-18..
tāsām saṃkrīḍa mānānām eṣa vāditra niḥsvanaḥ .śrūyate bhūṣaṇa unmiśraḥ gīta śabdaḥ manoharaḥ ..3-11-19..
āścaryam iti tasya etad vacanam bhāvitātmanaḥ .rāghavaḥ pratijagrāha saha bhrātrā mahā yaśāḥ ..3-11-20..
evam kathayamānaḥ sa dadarśa āśrama maṇḍalam .kuśa cīra parikṣiptam brāhmyā lakṣmyā samāvṛtam ..3-11-21..
praviśya saha vaidehyā lakṣmaṇena ca rāghavaḥ .tadā tasmin sa kākutsthaḥ śrīmati āśrama maṇḍale ..3-11-22..
uṣitvā sa sukham tatra pūrjyamāno maharṣibhiḥ .jagāma ca āśramān teṣām paryāyeṇa tapasvinām ..3-11-23..
yeṣām uṣitavān pūrvam sakāśe sa mahāstravit .kvacit paridaśān māsān eka saṃvatsaram kvacit ..3-11-24..
kvacit ca caturo māsān paṃca ṣaṭ ca parān kvacit .aparatra adhikān māsān adhyardham adhikam kvacit ..3-11-25..
trīn māsān aṣṭa māsān ca rāghavo nyavasat sukham .tatra saṃvasataḥ tasya munīnām āśrameṣu vai ..3-11-26..
ramataḥ ca ānukūlyena yayuḥ saṃvatsarā daśa .parisṛtya ca dharmajñaḥ rāghavaḥ saha sītayā ..3-11-27..
sutīkṣṇasya āśramam śrīmān punar eva ājagāma ha .sa tam āśramam āgamya munibhiḥ paripūjitaḥ ..3-11-28..
tatra api nyavasat rāmaḥ kaṃcit kālam arindamaḥ .atha āśramastho vinayāt kadācit tam mahāmunim ..3-11-29..
upāsīnaḥ sa kākutsthaḥ sutīkṣṇam idam abravīt .asmin araṇye bhagavan agastyo munisattamaḥ ..3-11-30..
vasati iti mayā nityam kathāḥ kathayatām śrutam .na tu jānāmi tam deśam vanasya asya mahattayā ..3-11-31..
kutra āśrama padam puṇyam maharṣeḥ tasya dhīmataḥ .prasāda artham bhagavataḥ sānujaḥ saha sītayā ..3-11-32..
agastyam abhigaccheyam abhivādayitum munim .manoratho mahān eṣa hṛdi parivartate ..3-11-33..
yadi aham tam munivaram śuśrūṣeyam api svayam .iti rāmasya sa muniḥ śrutvā dharmātmano vacaḥ ..3-11-34..
sutīkṣṇaḥ pratyuvāca idam prīto daśarathātmajam .aham api etad eva tvām vaktu kāmaḥ sa lakṣmaṇam ..3-11-35..
agastyam abhigaccha iti sītayā saha rāghava .diṣṭyā tu idānīm arthe asmin svayam eva bravīṣi mām ..3-11-36..
ayam ākhyāmi te rāma yatra agastyo mahāmuniḥ .yojanāni āśramāt tāta yāhi catvāri vai tataḥ .dakṣiṇena mahān śrīmān agastya bhrātur āśramaḥ ..3-11-37..
sthalī prāya vanoddeśe pippalī vana śobhite .bahu puṣpa phale ramye nānā vihaga nādite ..3-11-38..
padminyo vividhāḥ tatra prasanna salila āśayāḥ .haṃsa kāraṇḍava ākīrṇāḥ cakravāka upaśobhitāḥ ..3-11-39..
tatra ekām rajanīm vyuṣya prabhāte rāma gamyatām .dakṣiṇām diśam āsthāya vana ṣaṇḍasya pārśvataḥ ..3-11-40..
tatra agastya āśrama padam gatvā yojanam antaram .ramaṇīye vanoddeśe bahu pādapa śobhite ..3-11-41..
raṃsyate tatra vaidehī lakṣmaṇaḥ ca tvayā saha .sa hi ramyo vanouddeśo bahu pādapa saṃyutaḥ ..3-11-42..
yadi buddhiḥ kṛtā draṣṭum agastyam tam mahāmunim .adya eva gamane buddhim rocayasva mahāmate ..3-11-43..
iti rāmo muneḥ śrutvā saha bhrātrā abhivādya ca .pratasthe agastyam uddiśya sānugaḥ saha sītayā ..3-11-44..
paśyan vanāni citrāṇi parvatāṃ ca abhra saṃnibhān .sarāṃsi saritaḥ caiva pathi mārga vaśa anugatān ..3-11-45..
sutīkṣṇena upadiṣṭena gatvā tena pathā sukham .idam parama saṃhṛṣṭo vākyam lakṣmaṇam abravīt ..3-11-46..
etad eva āśrama padam nūnam tasya mahātmanaḥ .agastyasya muner bhrātur dṛśyate puṇya karmaṇaḥ ..3-11-47..
yathā hi ime vanasya asya jñātāḥ pathi sahasraśaḥ .saṃnatāḥ phala bhareṇa puṣpa bhāreṇa ca drumāḥ ..3-11-48..
pippalīnām ca pakvānām vanād asmād upāgataḥ .gandho ayam pavana utkṣiptaḥ sahasā kaṭukodayaḥ ..3-11-49..
tatra tatra ca dṛśyante saṃkṣiptāḥ kāṣṭha saṃcayāḥ .lūnāḥ ca paridṛśyante darbhā vaidūrya varcasaḥ ..3-11-50..
etat ca vana madhyastham kṛṣṇa abhra śikhara upamam .pāvakasya āśramasthasya dhūmāgram saṃpradṛśyate ..3-11-51..
vivikteṣu ca tīrtheṣu kṛta snānā dvijātayaḥ .puṣpa upahāram kurvanti kusumaiḥ svayam ārjitaiḥ ..3-11-52..
tataḥ sutīkṣṇasya vacanam yathā saumya mayā śrutam .agastyasya āśramo bhrātur nūnam eṣa bhaviṣyati ..3-11-53..
nigṛhya tarasā mṛtyum lokānām hita kāmyayā .yasya bhrātrā kṛtā iyam dik śaraṇyā puṇya karmaṇā ..3-11-54..
iha ekadā kila krūro vātāpiḥ api ca ilvalaḥ .bhrātarau sahitau āstām brāhmaṇaghnau mahā asurau ..3-11-55..
dhārayan brāhmaṇam rūpam ilvalaḥ saṃskṛtam vadan .āmaṃtrayati viprān sa śrāddham uddiśya nirghṛṇaḥ ..3-11-56..
bhrātaram saṃskṛtam kṛtvā tataḥ tam meṣa rūpiṇam .tān dvijān bhojayāmāsa śrāddha dṛṣṭena karmaṇā ..3-11-57..
tato bhuktavatām teṣām viprāṇām ilvalo abravīt .vātāpe niṣkramasva iti svareṇa mahatā vadan ..3-11-58..
tato bhrātur vacaḥ śrutvā vātāpiḥ meṣavat nadan .bhittvā bhitvā śarīrāṇi brāhmaṇānām viniṣpatat ..3-11-59..
brāhmaṇānām sahasrāṇi taiḥ evam kāma rūpibhiḥ .vināśitāni saṃhatya nityaśaḥ piśita aśanaiḥ ..3-11-60..
agastyena tadā devaiḥ prārthitena maharṣiṇā .anubhūya kila śrāddhe bhakṣitaḥ sa mahā asuraḥ ..3-11-61..
tataḥ saṃpannam iti uktvā dattvā haste avanejanam .bhrātaram niṣkramasva iti ca ilvalaḥ samabhāṣata ..3-11-62..
sa tadā bhāṣamāṇam tu bhrātaram vipra ghātinam .abravīt prahasan dhīmān agastyo muni sattamaḥ ..3-11-63..
kuto niṣkramitum śaktir mayā jīrṇasya rakṣasaḥ .bhrātuḥ te meṣa rūpasya gatasya yama sādanam ..3-11-64..
atha tasya vacaḥ śrutvā bhrātur nidhana saṃśritam .pradharṣayitum ārebhe munim krodhāt niśā caraḥ ..3-11-65..
so abhyadravat dvijeṃdram tam muninā dīpta tejasā .cakṣuṣā anala kalpena nirdagdho nidhanam gataḥ ..3-11-66..
tasya ayam āśramo bhrātuḥ taṭāka vana śobhitaḥ .vipra anukampayā yena karma idam duṣkaram kṛtam ..3-11-67..
evam kathayamānasya tasya saumitriṇā saha .rāmasya astam gataḥ sūryaḥ saṃdhyā kālo abhyavartata ..3-11-68..
upāsya paścimām saṃdhyām saha bhrātrā yathā vidhi .praviveśa āśrama padam tam ṛṣim ca abhyavādayat ..3-11-69..
samyak pratigṛhītaḥ tu muninā tena rāghavaḥ .nyavasat tām niśām ekām prāśya mūla phalāni ca ..3-11-70..
tasyām rātryām vyatītāyām udite ravi maṇḍale .bhrātaram tam agastyasya āmaṃtrayata rāghavaḥ ..3-11-71..
abhivādaye tvām bhagavan sukham sma uṣyato niśām .āmaṃtraye tvām gacchāmi gurum te draṣṭum agrajam ..3-11-72..
gamyatām iti tena ukto jagāma raghu nandanaḥ .yathā uddiṣṭena mārgeṇa vanam tat ca avalokayan ..3-11-73..
nīvārān panasān sālān vanjulān tiniśān tathā .ciri bilvān madhūkān ca bilvān atha ca tindukān ..3-11-74..
puṣpitān puṣpita agrābhir latābhir upaśobhitān .dadarśa rāmaḥ śataśaḥ tatra kāntāra pādapān ..3-11-75..
hasti hastaiḥ vimṛditān vānaraiḥ upaśobhitān .mattaiḥ śakuni saṃghaiḥ ca śataśaḥ prati nāditān ..3-11-76..
tato abravīt samīpastham rāmo rājīva locanaḥ .pṛṣṭhato anugatam vīram lakṣmaṇam lakṣmivardhanam ..3-11-77..
snigdha patrā yathā vṛkṣā yathā kṣāntā mṛga dvijāḥ .āśramo na atidūrastho maharṣer bhāvita ātmanaḥ ..3-11-78..
agastya iti vikhyāto loke svena eva karmaṇā .āśramo dṛśyate tasya pariśrānta śrama apahaḥ ..3-11-79..
prājya dhūma ākula vanaḥ cīra mālā pariṣkṛtaḥ .praśānta mṛga yūthaḥ ca nānā śakuni nāditaḥ ..3-11-80..
nigṛhya tarasā mṛtyum lokānām hita kāmyayā .dakṣiṇā dik kṛtā yena śaraṇyā puṇya karmaṇā ..3-11-81..
tasya idam āśrama padam prabhāvād yasya rākṣasaiḥ .dik iyam dakṣiṇā trāsād dṛśyate na upabhujyate ..3-11-82..
yadā prabhṛti ca ākrāntā dig iyam puṇya karmaṇā .tadā prabhṛti nir vairāḥ praśāntā rajanī carāḥ ..3-11-83..
nāmnā ca iyam bhagavato dakṣiṇā dik pradakṣiṇā .prathitā triṣu lokeṣu durdharṣā krūra karmabhiḥ ..3-11-84..
mārgam niroddhum satatam bhāskarasya acala uttamaḥ .saṃdeśam pālayan tasya viṃdhya śailo na vardhate ..3-11-85..
ayam dīrgha āyuṣaḥ tasya loke viśruta karmaṇaḥ .agastyasya āśramaḥ śrīmān vinīta mṛga sevitaḥ ..3-11-86..
eṣa loka arcitaḥ sādhuḥ hite nityam rataḥ satām .asmān adhigatān eṣa śreyasā yojayiṣyati ..3-11-87..
ārādhayiṣyāmi atra aham agastyam tam mahāmunim .śeṣam ca vana vāsasya saumya vatsyāmi aham prabho ..3-11-88..
atra devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāḥ ca parama ṛṣayaḥ .agastyam niyata āhārāḥ satatam paryupāsate ..3-11-89..
na atra jīvet mṛṣāvādī krūro vā yadi vā śaṭhaḥ .nṛśaṃsaḥ pāpa vṛtto vā muniḥ eṣa tathā vidhaḥ ..3-11-90..
atra devāḥ ca yakṣāḥ ca nāgāḥ ca patagaiḥ saha .vasanti niyata āhārā dharmam ārādhayiṣṇavaḥ ..3-11-91..
atra siddhā mahātmāno vimānaiḥ sūrya sannibhaiḥ .tyaktvā dehān navair dehaiḥ svar yātāḥ parama ṛṣayaḥ ..3-11-92..
yakṣatvam amaratvam ca rājyāni vividhāni ca .atra devāḥ prayacchanti bhūtaiḥ ārādhitāḥ śubhaiḥ ..3-11-93..
āgatāḥ sma āśrama padam saumitre praviśa agrataḥ .nivedaya iha mām prāptam ṛṣaye saha sītayā ..3-11-94..
sa praviśya āśrama padam lakṣmaṇo rāghava anujaḥ .agastya śiṣyam āsādya vākyam etad uvāca ha ..3-12-1..
rājā daśaratho nāma jyeṣṭhaḥ tasya suto balī .rāmaḥ prāpto munim draṣṭum bhāryayā saha sītayā ..3-12-2..
lakṣmaṇo nāma tasya aham bhrātā tu avarajo hitaḥ .anukūlaḥ ca bhaktaḥ ca yadi te śrotram āgataḥ ..3-12-3..
te vayam vanam atyugram praviṣṭāḥ pitṛ śāsanāt .draṣṭum icchāmahe sarve bhagavantam nivedyatām ..3-12-4..
tasya tad vacanam śrutvā lakṣmaṇasya tapodhanaḥ .tathā iti uktvā agni śaraṇam praviveśa niveditum ..3-12-5..
sa praviśya muniśreṣṭham tapasā duṣpradharṣaṇam .kṛta aṃjaliḥ uvāca idam rāma āgamanam añjasā ..3-12-6..
yathā uktam lakṣmaṇena eva śiṣyaḥ tasya agastasya saṃmataḥ .putrau daśarathasya imau rāmo lakṣmaṇa eva ca ..3-12-7..
praviṣṭau āśramapadam sītayā saha bhāryayā .draṣṭum bhavantam āyātau śuśrūṣārtham arindamau ..3-12-8..
yad atra anaṃtaram tat tvam ājñāpayitum arhasi .tataḥ śiṣyāt upaśrutya prāptam rāmam sa lakṣmaṇam ..3-12-9..
vaidehīm ca mahābhāgām idam vacanam abravīt .diṣṭyā rāmaḥ cirasya adya draṣṭum mām samupāgataḥ ..3-12-10..
manasā kāṃkṣitam hi asya mayā api āgamanam prati .gamyatām satkṛto rāmaḥ sa bhāryaḥ saha lakṣmaṇaḥ ..3-12-11..
praveśyatām samīpam me kim asau na praveśitaḥ .evam uktaḥ tu muninā dharmajñena mahātmanā ..3-12-12..
abhivādya abravīt śiṣyaḥ tathā iti niyata aṃjaliḥ .tadā niṣkramya saṃbhrāntaḥ śiṣyo lakṣmaṇam abravīt ..3-12-13..
kva asau rāmo munim draṣṭum etu praviśatu svayam .tato gatvā āśrama padam śiṣyeṇa saha lakṣmaṇaḥ ..3-12-14..
darśayāmāsa kākutstham sītām ca janakātmajām .tam śiṣyaḥ praśritam vākyam agastya vacanam bruvan ..3-12-15..
prāveśayat yathā nyāyam satkāra arha susatkṛtam .praviveśa tato rāmaḥ sītayā saha lakṣmaṇaḥ ..3-12-16..
praśānta hariṇa ākīrṇam āśramam hi avalokayan .sa tatra brahmaṇaḥ sthānam agneḥ sthānam tathaiva ca ..3-12-17..
viṣṇoḥ sthānam mahendrasya sthānam caiva vivasvataḥ .soma sthānam bhaga sthānam sthānam kauberam eva ca ..3-12-18..
dhātur vidhātuḥ sthānam ca vāyoḥ sthānam tathaiva ca .sthānam ca pāśa hastasya vāruṇasya mahātmanaḥ ..3-12-19..
sthānam tathaiva gāyatryā vasūnām sthānam eva ca .sthānam ca nāgarājasya garuḍa sthānam eva ca ..3-12-20..
kārtikeyasya ca sthānam dharma sthānam ca paśyati .tataḥ śiṣyaiḥ parivṛto munir api abhiniṣpatat ..3-12-21..
tam dadarśa agrato rāmo munīnām dīpta tejasam .abravīt vacanam vīro lakṣmaṇam lakṣmivardhanam ..3-12-22..
bahir lakṣmaṇa niṣkrāmati agastyo bhagavān ṛṣiḥ .audāryeṇa avagacchāmi nidhānam tapasām imam ..3-12-23..
evam uktvā mahābāhuḥ agastyam sūrya varcasam .jagrāha āpatat tasya pādau ca raghunandana ..3-12-24..
abhivādya tu dharmātmā tasthau rāmaḥ kṛtāṃjaliḥ .sītayā saha vaidehyā tadā rāmaḥ sa lakṣmaṇaḥ ..3-12-25..
pratigṛhya ca kākutstham arcayitvā āsana udakaiḥ .kuśala praśnam uktvā ca āsyatām iti so'bravīt ..3-12-26..
agnim hutvā pradāya arghyam atithin pratipūjya ca .vānaprasthena dharmeṇa sa teṣām bhojanam dadau ..3-12-27..
prathamam ca upaviśya atha dharmajño munipuṃgavaḥ .uvāca rāmam āsīnam prāṃjalim dharmakovidam ..3-12-28..
agnim hutvā pradāya arghyam atithim pratipūjayet .anyathā khalu kākutstha tapasvī samudācaran .duḥsākṣī iva pare loke svāni māṃsāni bhakṣayet ..3-12-29..
rājā sarvasya lokasya dharmacārī mahārathaḥ .pūjanīyaḥ ca mānyaḥ ca bhavān prāptaḥ priya atithiḥ ..3-12-30..
evam uktvā phalaiḥ mūlaiḥ puṣpaiḥ ca anyaiḥ ca rāghavam .pūjayitvā yathā kāmam tato agastyaḥ tam abravīt ..3-12-31..
idam divyam mahat cāpam hema vajra vibhūṣitam .vaiṣṇavam puruṣavyāghra nirmitam viśvakarmaṇā ..3-12-32..
amoghaḥ sūrya saṃkāśo brahmadattaḥ śara uttamaḥ .datto mama mahendreṇa tūṇī ca akṣaya sāyakau ..3-12-33..
saṃpūrṇau niśitaiḥ bāṇaiḥ jvaladbhiḥ iva pāvakaiḥ .mahā rajata kośo ayam asiḥ hemavibhūṣitaḥ ..3-12-34..
anena dhanuṣā rāma hatvā saṃkhye mahāsurān .ājahāra śriyam dīptām purā viṣṇur diva okasām ..3-12-35..
tat dhanuḥ tau ca tūṇi ca śaram khaḍgam ca mānada .jayāya pratigṛhṇīṣva vajram vajradharo yathā ..3-12-36..
evam uktvā mahā tejāḥ samastam tat vara āyudham .dattvā rāmāya bhagavān agastyaḥ punar abravīt ..3-12-37..
rāma prīto asmi bhadram te parituṣṭo asmi lakṣmaṇa .abhivādayitum yan mām prāptau sthaḥ saha sītayā ..3-13-1..
adhva śrameṇa vām khedo bādhate pracura śramaḥ .vyaktam utkaṇṭhate vā api maithilī janaka ātmajā ..3-13-2..
eṣā ca sukumārī ca khedaiḥ ca na vimānitā .prāajya doṣam vanam praptā bhartṛ sneha pracoditā ..3-13-3..
yathā eṣā ramate rāma iha sītā tathā kuru .duṣkaram kṛtavatī eṣā vane tvām abhigacchatī ..3-13-4..
eṣā hi prakṛtiḥ strīṇām āsṛṣṭe raghunaṃdana .samastham anuraṃjaṃte viṣamastham tyajanti ca ..3-13-5..
śata hradānām lolatvam śastrāṇām tīkṣṇatām tathā .garuḍa anilayoḥ śaighryam anugacchanti yoṣitaḥ ..3-13-6..
iyam tu bhavato bhāryā doṣair etair vivarjitāḥ .ślāghyā ca vyapadeśyā ca yathā devī hi arundhatī ..3-13-7..
alaṃkṛto ayam deśaḥ ca yatra saumitriṇā saha .vaidehyā ca anayā rāma vatsyasi tvam ariṃdama ..3-13-8..
evam uktaḥ tu muninā rāghavaḥ saṃyata aṃjaliḥ .uvāca praśritam vākyam ṛṣim dīptam iva analam ..3-13-9..
dhanyosmi anugṛhītosmi yasya me muni puṃgavaḥ .guṇaiḥ sabhrātṛ bhāryasya guruḥ naḥ parituṣyati ..3-13-10..
kintu vyādiśa me deśam sa udakam bahu kānanam .yatra āśrama padam kṛtvā vaseyam nirataḥ sukham ..3-13-11..
tato abravīt muni śreṣṭhaḥ śrutvā rāmasya bhāṣitam .dhyātvā muhūrtam dharmātmā dhīro dhīrataram vacaḥ ..3-13-12..
ito dvi yojane tāta bahu mūla phala udakaḥ .deśo bahu mṛgaḥ śrīmān paṃcavaṭi abhiviśrutaḥ ..3-13-13..
tatra gatvā āśrama padam kṛtvā saumitriṇā saha .ramasva tvam pitur vākyam yathā uktam anupālayan ..3-13-14..
vidito hi eṣa vṛttāṃto mama sarvaḥ tava anagha .tapasaḥ ca prabhāveṇa snehād daśarathasya ca ..3-13-15..
hṛdayasthaḥ ca te chando vijñātaḥ tapasā mayā .iha vāsam pratijñāya mayā saha tapo vane ..3-13-16..
ataḥ ca tvām aham brūmi gaccha paṃcavaṭīm iti .sa hi ramyo vanoddeśo maithilī tatra raṃsyate ..3-13-17..
sa deśaḥ ślāghanīyaḥ ca na atidūre ca rāghava .godāvaryāḥ samīpe ca maithilī tatra raṃsyate ..3-13-18..
prājya mūla phalaiḥ caiva nānā dvija gaṇair yutaḥ .viviktaḥ ca mahābāho puṇyo ramyaḥ tathaiva ca ..3-13-19..
bhavān api sadācāraḥ ca śaktaḥ ca parirakṣaṇe .api ca atra vasan rāma tāpasān pālayiṣyasi ..3-13-20..
etat ālakṣyate vīra madhūkānām mahat vanam .uttareṇa asya gaṃtavyam nyagrodham api gacchatā ..3-13-21..
tataḥ sthalam upāruhya parvatasya avidūrataḥ .khyātaḥ paṃcavaṭī iti eva nitya puṣpita kānanaḥ ..3-13-22..
agastyena evam uktaḥ tu rāmaḥ saumitriṇā saha .satkṛtya āmaṃtrayāmāsa tam ṛṣim satya vādinam ..3-13-23..
tau tu tena abhyanujñātau kṛta pāda abhivandanau .tam āśramam paṃcavaṭīm jagmatuḥ saha sītayā ..3-13-24..

gṛhīta cāpau tu narādhipa ātmajau
viṣakta tūṇī samareṣu akātarau .yathā upadiṣṭena pathā maharṣiṇā .prajagmatuḥ paṃcavaṭīm samāhitau ..3-13-25..
atha paṃcavaṭīm gaccann antarā raghunandanaḥ .āsasāda mahākāyam gṛdhram bhīma parākramam ..3-14-1..
tam dṛṣṭvā tau mahābhāgau vanastham rāma lakṣmaṇau .menāte rākṣasam pakṣim bruvāṇau ko bhavān iti ..3-14-2..
sa tau madhurayā vācā saumyayā prīṇayann iva .uvāca vatsa mām viddhi vayasyam pitur ātmanaḥ ..3-14-3..
sa tam pitṛ sakham matvā pūjayāmāsa rāghavaḥ .sa tasya kulam avyagram atha papraccha nāma ca ..3-14-4..
rāmasya vacanam śrutvā kulam ātmānam eva ca .ācacakṣe dvijaḥ tasmai sarvabhūta samudbhavam ..3-14-5..
pūrvakāle mahābāho ye prajāpatayo abhavan .tān me nigadataḥ sarvān āditaḥ śṛṇu rāghava ..3-14-6..
kardamaḥ prathamaḥ teṣām vikṛtaḥ tad anantaram .śeṣaḥ ca saṃśrayaḥ caiva bahu putraḥ ca vīryavān  ..3-14-7..
sthāṇur marīcir atriḥ ca kratuḥ caiva mahābalaḥ .pulastyaḥ ca aṃgirāḥ caiva pracetāḥ pulahaḥ tathā ..3-14-8..
dakṣo vivasvān aparo ariṣṭanemiḥ ca rāghava .kaśyapaḥ ca mahātejāḥ teṣām āsīt ca paścimaḥ ..3-14-9..
prajāpateḥ tu dakṣasya babhūvur iti  viśrutam .ṣaṣṭir duhitaro rāma yaśasvinyo mahāyaśaḥ ..3-14-10..
kaśyapaḥ pratijagrāha tāsām aṣṭau sumadhyamāḥ .aditim ca ditim caiva danūm api ca kālakām ..3-14-11..
tāmrām krodha vaśām caiva manum ca apy analām api .tāḥ tu kanyāḥ tataḥ prītaḥ kaśyapaḥ punar abravīt ..3-14-12..
putrāmaḥ trailokya bhartṝn vai janayiṣyatha mat samān .aditiḥ tan manā rāma ditiḥ ca danur eva ca ..3-14-13..
kālakā ca mahābāho śeṣāḥ tu amanaso abhavan .adityām jajñire devāḥ trayaḥ triṃśat ariṃdama ..3-14-14..
ādityā vasavo rudrā aśvinau ca paraṃtapa .ditiḥ tu ajanayat putrān daityām tāta yaśasvinaḥ ..3-14-15..
teṣām iyam vasumatī purā āsīt sa vana arṇavā .danuḥ tu ajanayat putram aśvagrīvam ariṃdama ..3-14-16..
narakam kālakam caiva kālakā api vyajāyata .krauncīm bhāsīm tathā śyenīm dhṛtarāṣṭrīm tathā śukīm ..3-14-17..
tāmrā tu suṣuve kanyāḥ paṃca etā lokaviśrutāḥ .ulūkān janayat krauncī bhāsī bhāsān vyajāyata ..3-14-18..
śyenī śyenām ca gṛdhrāma ca vyajāyata sutejasaḥ .dhṛtarāṣṭrī tu haṃsām ca kalahaṃsām ca sarvaśaḥ ..3-14-19..
cakravākām ca bhadram te vijajñe sā api bhāminī .śukī natām vijajñe tu natāyā vinatā sutā ..3-14-20..
daśa krodhavaśā rāma vijajñe api ātmasaṃbhavāḥ .mṛgīm ca mṛgamaṃdām ca harīm bhadramadām api ..3-14-21..
mātaṃgīm atha śārdūlīm śvetām ca surabhīm tathā .sarva lakṣaṇa saṃpannām surasām kadrukām api ..3-14-22..
apatyam tu mṛgāḥ sarve mṛgyā naravarottama .ṛkṣāḥ ca mṛgamaṃdāyāḥ sṛmarāḥ camarāḥ tathā ..3-14-23..
tataḥ tu irāvatīm nāma jajñe bhadramadā sutām .tasyāḥ tu airāvataḥ putro lokanātho mahāgajaḥ ..3-14-24..
haryāḥ ca harayo apatyam vānarāḥ ca tapasvinaḥ .golāṃgūlāḥ ca śārdūlī vyāghrām ca ajanayat sutān ..3-14-25..
mātaṃgyāḥ tu atha mātangāapatyam manuja ṛṣabha .diśāgajam tu śveta kākutstha śvetā vyajanayat sutam ..3-14-26..
tato duhitarau rāma surabhir dve vi ajāyata .rohiṇīm nāma bhadram te gandharvīm ca yaśasvinīm ..3-14-27..
rohiṇi ajanayad gāvo gandharvī vājinaḥ sutān .surasā ajanayan nāgān rāma kadrūḥ ca pannagān ..3-14-28..
manur manuṣyān janayat kaśyapasya mahātmanaḥ .brāhmaṇān kṣatriyān vaiśyān śūdrām ca manujarṣabha ..3-14-29..
mukhato brāhmaṇā jātā urasaḥ kṣatriyāḥ tathā .ūrubhyām jajñire vaiśyāḥ padbhyām śūdrā iti śrutiḥ ..3-14-30..
sarvān puṇya phalān vṛkṣān analā api vyajāyata .vinatā ca śukī pautrī kadrūḥ ca surasā svasā ..3-14-31..
kadrūr nāga sahasram tu vijajñe dharaṇīdharan .dvau putrau vinatāyāḥ tu garuḍo aruṇa eva ca ..3-14-32..
tasmāt jāto aham aruṇāt saṃpātiḥ ca mama agrajaḥ .jaṭāyur iti mām viddhi śyenī putram ariṃdama ..3-14-33..
so aham vāsa sahāyaḥ te bhaviṣyāmi yadi icchasi .idam durgam hi kāntāram mṛga rākṣasa sevitam sītām ca tāta rakṣiṣye tvayi yāte salakṣmaṇe ..3-14-34..
jaṭāyuṣam tu pratipūjya rāghavo mudā pariṣvajya ca sannato abhavat .pitur hi śuśrāva sakhitvam ātmavān jaṭāyuṣā saṃkathitam punaḥ punaḥ ..3-14-35..
sa tatra sītām paridāya maithilīm saha eva tena atibalena pakṣiṇā .jagāma tām paṃcavaṭīm salakṣmaṇo ripūn didhakṣan śalabhān iva analaḥ  ..3-14-36..
tataḥ paṃcavaṭīm gatvā nānā vyāla mṛgāyutām .uvāca bhrātaram rāmo lakṣmaṇam dīpta tejasam ..3-15-1..
āgatāḥ sma yathā uddiṣṭam yam deśam muniḥ abravīt .ayam paṃcavaṭī deśaḥ saumya puṣpita kānanaḥ ..3-15-2..
sarvataḥ cāryatām dṛṣṭiḥ kānane nipuṇo hi asi .āśramaḥ katara asmin naḥ deśe bhavati sammataḥ ..3-15-3..
ramate yatra vaidehī tvam aham caiva lakṣmaṇa .tādṛśo dṛśyatām deśaḥ saṃnikṛṣṭa jalāśayaḥ ..3-15-4..
vana rāmaṇyakam yatra jala rāmaṇyakam tathā .saṃnikṛṣṭam ca yasmin tu samit puṣpa kuśa udakam ..3-15-5..
evam uktaḥ tu rāmeṇa lakmaṇaḥ saṃyata aṃjaliḥ .sītā samakṣam kākutstham idam vacanam abravīt ..3-15-6..
paravān asmi kākutstha tvayi varṣa śatam sthite .svayam tu rucire deśe kriyatām iti mām vada ..3-15-7..
suprītaḥ tena vākyena lakṣmaṇasya mahādyutiḥ .vimṛśan rocayāmāsa deśam sarva guṇa anvitam ..3-15-8..
sa tam ruciram ākramya deśam āśrama karmaṇi .haste gṛhītvā hastena rāmaḥ saumitrim abravīt ..3-15-9..
ayam deśaḥ samaḥ śrīmān puṣpitair tarubhir vṛtaḥ .iha āśrama padam saumya yathāvat kartum arhasi ..3-15-10..
iyam āditya saṃkāśaiḥ padmaiḥ surabhi gaṃdhibhiḥ .adūre dṛśyate ramyā padminī padma śobhitā ..3-15-11..
yathā ākhyātam agastyena muninā bhāvitātmanā .iyam godāvarī ramyā puṣpitaiḥ tarubhir vṛtā ..3-15-12..
haṃsa kāraṇḍava ākīrṇā cakravāka upaśobhitā .na atidūre na ca āsanne mṛga yūtha nipīḍitā ..3-15-13..
mayūra nāditā ramyāḥ prāṃśavo bahu kaṃdarāḥ .dṛśyante girayaḥ saumya phullaiḥ tarubhir āvṛtāḥ ..3-15-14..
sauvarṇai rājataiḥ tāmraiḥ deśe deśe ca dhātubhiḥ .gavākṣitā iva ābhānti gajāḥ parama bhaktibhiḥ ..3-15-15..
sālaiḥ tālaiḥ tamālaiḥ ca kharjūraiḥ panasaiḥ drumaiḥ .nīvāraiḥ tiniśaiḥ caiva punnāgaiḥ ca upaśobhitāḥ ..3-15-16..
cūtair aśokaiḥ tilakaiḥ ketakair api caṃpakaiḥ  .puṣpa gulma latā upetaiḥ taiḥ taiḥ tarubhir āvṛtāḥ ..3-15-17..
syandanaiḥ caṃdanaiḥ  nīpaiḥ parṇāsaiḥ lakucaiḥ api .dhava aśvakarṇa khadiraiḥ śamī kiṃśuka pāṭalaiḥ ..3-15-18..
idam puṇyam idam ramyam idam bahu mṛga dvijam .iha vatsyāma saumitre sārdham etena pakṣiṇā ..3-15-19..
evam uktaḥ tu rāmeṇa lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā .acireṇa āśramam bhrātuḥ cakāra sumahābalaḥ ..3-15-20..
parṇaśālām suvipulām tatra saṃghāta mṛttikām .sustaṃbhām maskarair dīrghaiḥ kṛta vaṃśām suśobhanām ..3-15-21..
śamī śākhābhiḥ āstīrya dhṛḍha pāśāvapāśitam .kuśa kāśa śaraiḥ parṇaiḥ suparicchāditām tathā ..3-15-22..
samīkṛta talām ramyām cakāra sumahābalaḥ .nivāsam rāghavasya arthe prekṣṇīyam anuttamam ..3-15-23..
sa gatvā lakṣmaṇaḥ śrīmān nadīm godāvarīm tadā .snātvā padmāni ca ādāya saphalaḥ punar āgataḥ ..3-15-24..
tataḥ puṣpa balim kṛtvā śāntim ca sa yathāvidhi .darśayāmāsa rāmāya tad āśrama padam kṛtam ..3-15-25..
sa tam dṛṣṭvā kṛtam saumyam āśramam saha sītayā .rāghavaḥ parṇaśālāyām harṣam āhārayat param ..3-15-26..
susaṃhṛṣṭaḥ pariṣvajya bāhubhyām lakṣmaṇam tadā .ati snigdham ca gāḍham ca vacanam ca idam abravīt ..3-15-27..
prīto asmi te mahat karma tvayā kṛtam idam prabho .pradeyo yan nimittam te pariṣvaṃgo mayā kṛtaḥ ..3-15-28..
bhāvajñena kṛtajñena dharmajñena ca lakṣmaṇa .tvayā putreṇa dharmātmā na saṃvṛttaḥ pitā mama ..3-15-29..
evam lakṣmaṇam uktvā tu rāghavo lakṣmivardhanaḥ .tasmin deśe bahu phale nyavasat sa sukham sukhī ..3-15-30..
vasataḥ tasya tu sukham rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ .śarad vyapāye hemaṃtaṛtur iṣṭaḥ pravartata ..3-16-1..
sa kadācit prabhātāyām śarvaryām raghunaṃdanaḥ .prayayāva abhiṣekārtham ramyam godāvarīm nadīm ..3-16-2..
prahvaḥ kalaśa hasataḥ tam sītayā saha vīryavān .pṛṣṭhato anuvrajan bhrātā saumitrir idam abravīt ..3-16-3..
ayam sa kālaḥ saṃprāptaḥ priyo yaḥ te priyaṃvada .alaṃkṛta iva ābhāti yena saṃvatsaraḥ śubhaḥ ..3-16-4..
nīhāra paruṣo lokaḥ pṛthivī sasya mālinī .jalāni anupabhogyāni subhago havya vāhanaḥ ..3-16-5..
nava āgrayaṇa pūjābhir abhyarcya pitṛ devatāḥ .kṛta āgrayaṇakāḥ kāle santo vigata kalmaṣāḥ ..3-16-6..
prājyakāmā janapadāḥ saṃpannatara go rasāḥ .vicaranti mahīpālā yātra artham vijigīṣavaḥ ..3-16-7..
sevamāne dṛḍham sūrye diśam antaka sevitām .vihīna tilakā iva strī na uttarā dik prakāśate ..3-16-8..
prakṛtyā hima kośa āḍhyo dūra sūryāḥ ca sāṃpratam .yathārtha nāmā suvyaktam himavān himavān giriḥ ..3-16-9..
atyanta sukha saṃcārā madhyāhne sparśataḥ sukhāḥ .divasāḥ subhaga ādityāaḥ chāyā salila durbhagāḥ ..3-16-10..
mṛdu sūryāḥ sanīhārāḥ paṭu śītāḥ samārutāḥ .śūnya araṇyā hima dhvastā divasā bhānti sāmpratam ..3-16-11..
nivṛtta ākāśa śayanāḥ puṣyanītā hima aruṇāḥ .śītā vṛddhatara āyāmaḥ tri yāmā yānti sāṃpratam ..3-16-12..
ravi saṃkrānta saubhāgyaḥ tuṣāra aruṇa maṇḍalaḥ .niḥśvāsa andha iva ādarśāḥ caṃdramā na prakāśate ..3-16-13..
jyotsnā tuṣāra malinā paurṇamāsyām na rājate .sītā iva ca ātapa śyāmā lakṣyate na tu śobhate ..3-16-14..
prakṛtyā śītala sparśo hima viddhāḥ ca sāṃpratam .pravāti paścimo vāyuḥ kāle dvi guṇa śītalaḥ ..3-16-15..
bāṣpa cchannāni araṇyāni yava godhūmavaṃti ca .śobhante abhyudite sūrye nadadbhiḥ kraunca sārasaiḥ ..3-16-16..
kharjūra puṣpa ākṛtibhiḥ śirobhiḥ pūrṇa taṇḍulaiḥ .śobhante kiṃcid ālaṃbāḥ śālayaḥ kanaka prabhāḥ ..3-16-17..
mayūkhaiḥ upasarpadbhiḥ hima nīhāra saṃvṛtaiḥ .dūram abhyuditaḥ sūryaḥ śaśāṃka iva lakṣyate ..3-16-18..
agrāhya vīryaḥ pūrvāhṇe madhyāhne sparśataḥ sukhaḥ .saṃraktaḥ kiṃcid āpāṇḍuḥ ātapaḥ śobhate kṣitau ..3-16-19..
avaśyāya nipātena kiṃcit praklinna śādvalā .vanānām śobhate bhūmir niviṣṭa taruṇa ātapā ..3-16-20..
spṛśan tu suvipulam śītam udakam dviradaḥ sukham .atyanta tṛṣito vanyaḥ pratisaṃharate karam ..3-16-21..
ete hi samupāsīnā vihagā jalacāriṇaḥ .na avagāhanti salilam apragalbhā iva āvaham ..3-16-22..
avaśyāya tamo naddhā nīhāra tamasā āvṛtāḥ .prasuptā iva lakṣyante vipuṣpā vana rājayaḥ ..3-16-23..
bāṣpa saṃcanna salilā ruta vijñeya sārasāḥ .himāardra vālukaiḥ tīraiḥ sarito bhānti sāṃpratam ..3-16-24..
tuṣāra patanāt caiva mṛdutvāt bhāskarasya ca .śaityāt aga agrastham api prāyeṇa rasavat jalam ..3-16-25..
jarā jarjaritaiḥ patraiḥ śīrṇa kesara karṇikaiḥ .nāla śeṣā hima dhvastā na bhānti kamalākarāḥ ..3-16-26..
asmin tu puruṣavyāghra kāle duḥkha samanvitaḥ .tapaścarati dharmātmā tvat bhaktyā bharataḥ pure ..3-16-27..
tyaktvā rājyam ca mānam ca bhogāṃśca vividhān bahūn .tapasvī niyatāhāraḥ śete śīte mahītale ..3-16-28..
so'pi velām imām nūnam abhiṣeka artham udyataḥ .vṛtaḥ prakṛtibhir nityam prayāti sarayūm nadīm ..3-16-29..
atyanta sukha saṃvṛddhaḥ sukumāro himārditaḥ .katham tu apara rātreṣu sarayūm avagāhate ..3-16-30..
padmapatrekṣaṇaḥ śyāmaḥ śrīmān nirudaro mahān .dharmajñaḥ satyavādī ca hrī niṣedho jitendriyaḥ ..3-16-31..
priyābhibhāṣī madhuro dīrghabāhuḥ arindamaḥ .saṃtyajya vividhān bhogān āryam sarvātmanā āśritaḥ ..3-16-32..
jitaḥ svargaḥ tava bhrātrā bharatena mahātmanā .vanastham api tāpasye yaḥ tvām anuvidhīyate ..3-16-33..
na pitryam anuvarntante mātṛkam dvipadā iti .khyāto loka pravādo ayam bharatena anyathā kṛtaḥ ..3-16-34..
bhartā daśaratho yasyāḥ sādhuḥ ca bharataḥ sutaḥ .katham nu sā ambā kaikeyī tādṛśī krūradarśinī ..3-16-35..
iti evam lakṣmaṇe vākyam snehāt vadati dharmike .parivādam jananyaḥ tam asahan rāghavo abravīt ..3-16-36..
na te ambā madhyamā tāta garhitavyā kathaṃcana .tām eva ikṣvāku nāthasya bharatasya kathām kuru ..3-16-37..
niścitā eva hi me buddhiḥ vana vāse dṛḍha vratā .bharata sneha saṃtaptā bāliśī kriyate punaḥ ..3-16-38..
saṃsmarāmi asya vākyāni priyāṇi madhurāṇi ca .hṛdyāni amṛta kalpāni manaḥ prahlādāni ca ..3-16-39..
kadā hi aham sameṣyāmi bharatena mahātmanā .śatrughnena ca vīreṇa tvayā ca raghunaṃdana ..3-16-40..
iti evam vilapan tatra prāpya godāvarīm nadīm .cakre abhiṣekam kākutsthaḥ sānujaḥ saha sītayā ..3-16-41..
tarpayitvā atha salilaiḥ taiḥ pitṝn daivatāni ca .stuvanti sma uditam sūryam devatāaḥ ca tathā anaghāḥ..3-16-42..
kṛtābhiṣekaḥ sa rarāja rāmaḥ sītā  dvitīyaḥ saha lakṣmaṇena .kṛta abhiṣeko tu aga rāja putryā rudraḥ sa nandiḥ bhagavān iva īśaḥ ..3-16-43..
kṛta abhiṣeko rāmaḥ tu sītā saumitrir eva ca .tasmāt godāvarī tīrāt tato jagmuḥ svam āśramam ..3-17-1..
āśramam tam upāgamya rāghavaḥ saha lakṣmaṇaḥ .kṛtvā paurvāhṇikam karma parṇaśālām upāgamat ..3-17-2..
uvāsa sukhitaḥ tatra pūjyamāno maharṣabhaḥ.sa rāmaḥ parṇa śālāyām āsīnaḥ saha sītayā ..3-17-3..
virarāja mahā bāhuḥ citrayā candramā iva .lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā cakāra vividhāḥ kathāḥ ..3-17-4..
tadā āsīnasya rāmasya kathā saṃsakta cetasaḥ .tam deśam rākṣasī kācid ājagāma yadṛcchayā ..3-17-5..
sā tu śūrpaṇakhā nāma daśagrīvasya rakṣasaḥ .bhaginī rāmam āsādya dadarśa tridaśa upamam ..3-17-6..
dīptāsyam ca mahābāhum padma patrāyata  īkṣaṇam .gaja vikrāṃta gamanam jaṭā maṇdala dhāriṇam ..3-17-7..
sukumāram mahā sattvam pārthiva vyaṃjana anvitam .rāmam indīvara śyāmam kandarpa sadṛśa prabham ..3-17-8..
babhūva indropamam dṛṣṭvā rākṣasī kāma mohitā .sumukham durmukhī rāmam vṛtta madhyam mahodarī ..3-17-9..
viśālākṣam virūpākṣī sukeśam tāmra mūrdhajā .priyarūpam virūpā sā susvaram bhairava svanā ..3-17-10..
taruṇam dāruṇā vṛddhā dakṣiṇam vāma bhāṣiṇī .nyāya vṛttam sudurvṛttā priyam apriya darśanā ..3-17-11..
śarīraja samāviṣṭā rākṣasī rāmam abravīt .jaṭī tāpasa rūpeṇa sabhāryaḥ śara cāpa dhṛk ..3-17-12..
āgataḥ tvam imam deśam katham rākṣasa sevitam .kim āgamana kṛtyam te tat tvam ākhyātum arhasi ..3-17-13..
evam uktaḥ tu rākṣasyā śūrpaṇakhyā paraṃtapaḥ .ṛju buddhitayā sarvam ākhyātum upacakrame ..3-17-14..
āsīt daśaratho nāma rājā tridaśa vikramaḥ .tasya aham agrajaḥ putro rāmo nāma janaiḥ śrutaḥ ..3-17-15..
bhrātā ayam lakṣmaṇo nāma yavīyān mām anuvrataḥ .iyam bhāryā ca vaidehī mama sīteti viśrutā ..3-17-16..
niyogāt tu narendrasya pitur mātuḥ ca yaṃtritaḥ .dharmārtham dharmakāṃkṣī ca vanam vastum iha āgataḥ ..3-17-17..
tvām tu veditum icchāmi kasya tvam kā asi kasya vā .tvam hi tāvanmanojñāṃgī rākṣasī pratibhāsi me ..3-17-18..
iha vā kim nimittam tvam āgatā brūhi tattvataḥ .sā abravīt vacanam śrutvā rākṣasī madana arditā ..3-17-19..
śrūyatām rāma vakṣyāmi tattvārtham vacanam mama .aham śūrpaṇakhā nāma rākṣasī kāmarūpiṇī ..3-17-20..
araṇyam vicarāmi idam ekā sarva bhayaṃkarā .rāvaṇo nāma me bhrātā yadi te śrotram āgataḥ ..3-17-21..
vīro viśravasaḥ putro yadi te śrotram āgataḥ .pravṛddha nidraḥ ca sadā kuṃbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ ..3-17-22..
vibhīṣaṇaḥ tu dharmātmā na tu rākṣasa ceṣṭitaḥ .prakhyāta vīryau ca raṇe bhrātarau khara dūṣaṇau ..3-17-23..
tān aham samatikrāntā rāma tvā pūrva darśanāt .samupetā asmi bhāvena bhartāram puruṣottamam ..3-17-24..
aham prabhāva saṃpannā svacchaṃda bala gāminī .cirāya bhava bhartā me sītayā kim kariṣyasi ..3-17-25..
vikṛtā ca virūpā ca na sā iyam sadṛśī tava .aham eva anurūpā te bhāryā rūpeṇa paśya mām ..3-17-26..
imām virūpām asatīm karālām nirṇata udarīm .anena saha te bhrātrā bhakṣayiṣyāmi mānuṣīm ..3-17-27..
tataḥ parvata śṛṃgāṇi vanāni vividhāni ca .paśyansahamayākāmīdaṇḍakānvicariṣyasi - yadvā - paśyan saha mayā kāmī daṇḍakān vicariṣyasi ..3-17-28..
iti evam uktaḥ kākutsthaḥ prahasya madira īkṣaṇām .idam vacanam ārebhe vaktum vākya viśāradaḥ ..3-17-29..
tām tu śūrpaṇakhām rāmaḥ kāma pāśa avapāśitām .svacchayā ślakṣṇayā vācā smita pūrvam atha abravīt ..3-18-1..
kṛta dāro asmi bhavati bhāryā iyam dayitā mama .tvat vidhānām tu nārīṇām suduḥkhā sasapatnatā ..3-18-2..
anujaḥ tu eṣa me bhrātā śīlavān priya darśanaḥ .śrīmān akṛta dāraḥ ca lakṣmaṇo nāma vīryavān ..3-18-3..
apūrvī bhāryayā ca arthī taruṇaḥ priya darśanaḥ .anurūpaḥ ca te bhartā rūpasya asya bhaviṣyati ..3-18-4..
enam bhaja viśālākṣi bhartāram bhrātaram mama .asapatnā varārohe merum arka prabhā yathā ..3-18-5..
iti rāmeṇa sā proktā rākṣasī kāma mohitā .visṛjya rāmam sahasā tato lakṣmaṇam abravīt ..3-18-6..
asya rūpasya te yuktā bhāryā aham varavarṇinī .mayā saha sukham sarvān daṇḍakān vicariṣyasi ..3-18-7..
evam uktaḥ tu saumitrī rākṣasyā vākya kovidaḥ .tataḥ śūrpaṇakhīm smitvā lakṣmaṇo yuktam abravīt ..3-18-8..
katham dāsasya me dāsī bhāryā bhavitum icchasi .so aham āryeṇa paravān bhrātrā kamala varṇinī ..3-18-9..
samṛddha arthasya siddhārthā mudita amala varṇinī .āryasya tvam viśālākṣi bhāryā bhava yavīyasī ..3-18-10..
enām virūpām asatīm karālām nirṇata udarīm .bhāryām vṛddhām parityajya tvām eva eṣa bhajiṣyati ..3-18-11..
ko hi rūpam idam śreṣṭham saṃtyajya varavarṇini .mānuṣeṣu varārohe kuryāt bhāvam vicakṣaṇaḥ ..3-18-12..
iti sā lakṣmaṇena uktā karālā nirṇatodarī .manyate tat vacaḥ satyam parihāsa avicakṣaṇā ..3-18-13..
sā rāmam parṇaśālāyām upaviṣṭam paraṃtapam .sītayā saha durdharṣam abravīt kāma mohitā ..3-18-14..
imām virūpām asatīm karālām nirṇatodarīm .vṛddhām bhāryām avaṣṭabhya na mām tvam bahu manyase ..3-18-15..
adya imām bhakṣayiṣyāmi paśyataḥ tava mānuṣīm .tvayā saha cariṣyāmi niḥsapatnā yathā sukham ..3-18-16..
iti uktvā mṛgaśāvākṣīm alāta sadṛśa īkṣaṇā .abhyadhāvat susaṃkruddhā mahā ulkā rohiṇīm iva ..3-18-17..
tām mṛtyu pāśa pratimām āpataṃtīm mahābalaḥ .vigṛhya rāmaḥ kupitaḥ tato lakṣmaṇam abravīt ..3-18-18..
krūraiḥ anāryaiḥ saumitre parihāsaḥ kathaṃcana .na kāryaḥ paśya vaidehīm kathaṃcit saumya jīvatīm ..3-18-19..
imām virūpām asatīm atimattām mahodarīm .rākṣasīm puruṣavyāghra virūpayitum arhasi ..3-18-20..
iti ukto lakṣmaṇaḥ tasyāḥ kruddho rāmasya paśyataḥ .uddhṛtya khaḍgam ciccheda karṇa nāsam mahābalaḥ ..3-18-21..
nikṛtta karṇa nāsā tu visvaram sā vinadya ca .yathā āgatam pradudrāva ghorā śūrpaṇakhā vanam ..3-18-22..
sā virūpā mahāghorā rākṣasī śoṇita ukṣitā .nanāda vividhān nādān yathā prāvṛṣi toyadaḥ ..3-18-23..
sā vikṣaraṃtī rudhiram bahudhā ghora darśanā .pragṛhya bāhū garjantī praviveśa mahāvanam ..3-18-24..
tataḥ tu sā rākṣasa saṃgha samvṛtam kharam jana sthāna gatam virūpitā .upetya tam bhrātaram ugra tejasam papāta bhūmau gaganād yathā aśaniḥ ..3-18-25..
tataḥ sabhāryam bhaya moha mūrcitā salakṣmaṇam rāghavam āgatam vanam .virūpaṇam ca ātmani śoṇita ukṣitā śaśamsa sarvam bhaginī kharasya sā ..3-18-26..
tām tathā patitām dṛṣṭvā virūpām śoṇita ukṣitām .bhaginīm krodha saṃtaptaḥ kharaḥ papraccha rākṣasaḥ ..3-19-1..
uttiṣṭha tāvat ākhyāhi pramoham jahi saṃbhramam .vyaktam ākhyāhi kena tvam evam rūpā virūpitā ..3-19-2..
kaḥ kṛṣṇa sarpam asīnam āśī viṣama nāgasam .tudati abhisamāpannam aṃguli agreṇa līlayā ..3-19-3..
kāla pāśam samāsajya kaṇṭhe mohāt na jānate .yaḥ tvām adya samāsādya pītavān viṣam uttamam ..3-19-4..
bala vikrama saṃpannā kāmagā kāma rūpiṇī .imām avasthām nītā tvam kena aṃtaka samā gatā ..3-19-5..
deva gandharva bhūtānām ṛṣīṇām ca mahātmanām .ko ayam evam mahāvīryaḥ tvām virūpām cakāra ha ..3-19-6..
na hi paśyāmi aham loke yaḥ kuryāt mama vipriyam .amareṣu sahasrākṣam mahaendram pākaśāsanam ..3-19-7..
adya aham mārgaṇaiḥ prāṇān ādāsye jīvitāṃtagaiḥ .salile kṣīram āsaktam niṣpiban iva sārasaḥ ..3-19-8..
nihatasya mayā saṃkhye śara saṃkṛtta marmaṇaḥ .saphenam rudhiram kasya medinī pātum icchasi ..3-19-9..
kasya patrarathāḥ kāyāt māṃsam utkṛtya saṃgatāḥ .prahṛṣṭā bhakṣayiṣyanti nihatasya mayā raṇe ..3-19-10..
tam na devā na gaṃdharvā na piśācā na rākṣasāḥ .mayā apakṛṣṭam kṛpaṇam śaktāḥ trātum iha āhave ..3-19-11..
upalabhya śanaiḥ saṃjñām tam me śaṃsitum arhasi .yena tvam durvinītena vane vikramya nirjitā ..3-19-12..
iti bhrātur vacaḥ śrutvā kruddhasya ca viśeṣataḥ .tataḥ śūrpaṇakhā vākyam sabāṣpam idam abravīt ..3-19-13..
taruṇau rūpa saṃpannau sukūmārau mahābalau .puṇḍarīka viśālākṣau cīra kṛṣṇa ajina aṃbarau ..3-19-14..
phala mūla aśinau dāntau tāpasau brahmacāriṇau .putrau daśarathasya āstām bhrātarau rāma lakṣmanau ..3-19-15..
gandharva rāja pratimau pārthiva vyanjana anvitau .devau vā dānavau - mānuṣau - vā tau na tarkayitum utsahe ..3-19-16..
taruṇī rūpasaṃpannā sarvāabharaṇa bhūṣitā .dṛṣṭā tatra mayā nārī tayor madhye sumadhyamā ..3-19-17..
tābhyām ubhābhyām saṃbhūya pramadām adhikṛtya tām .imām avasthām nītā aham yathā anāthā satī tathā ..3-19-18..
tasyāḥ ca anṛju vṛttāyāḥ tayoḥ ca hatayor aham .saphenam pātum icchāmi rudhiram raṇa mūrdhani ..3-19-19..
eṣa me prathamaḥ kāmaḥ kṛtaḥ tatra tvayā bhavet .tasyāḥ tayoḥ ca rudhiram pibeyam aham āhave ..3-19-20..
iti tasyām bruvāṇāyām catur daśa mahābalān .vyādideśa kharaḥ kruddho rākṣasān aṃtakopamān ..3-19-21..
mānuṣau śastra sampannau cīra kṛṣṇa ajina aṃbarau .praviṣṭau daṇḍakāraṇyam ghoram pramadayā saha ..3-19-22..
tau hatvā tām ca durvṛttām upāvartitum arhatha .iyam ca rudhiram teṣām bhaginī mama pāsyati ..3-19-23..
manoratho ayam iṣṭo asyā bhaginyā mama rākṣasāḥ .śīghram saṃpadyatām gatvā tau pramathya sva tejasā ..3-19-24..
yuṣmābiḥ nirhato dṛṣṭvā tau ubhau bhrātau raṇe .iyam prahṛṣṭā muditā rudhiram yudhi pāsyati ..3-19-25..
iti pratisamādiṣṭā rākṣasāḥ te catur daśa .tatra jagmuḥ tayā sārdham ghanā vāteritāḥ yathā ..3-19-26..

tatastu te tam samudarga tejasam
tathāpi tīkṣṇa pradarā niśācarā .na śekur enam sahasā pramarditum
vanadvipā dīptvam iva agnim uthitam ..3-19-27..
tataḥ śūrpaṇakhā ghorā rāghava āśramam āgatā .rakṣasān ācacakṣe tau bhrātarau saha sītayā ..3-20-1..
te rāmam parṇa śālāyām upaviṣṭam mahābalam .dadṛśuḥ sītayā sārdham lakṣmaṇena api sevitam ..3-20-2..
tām dṛṣṭvā rāghavaḥ śrīmān āgatām tām ca rākṣasīm .abravīt bhrātaram rāmo lakṣmaṇam dīpta tejasam ..3-20-3..
muhūrtam bhava saumitre sītāyāḥ pratyanaṃtaraḥ .imān asyā vadhiṣyāmi padavīm āgatān iha ..3-20-4..
vākyam etat tataḥ śrutvā rāmasya vidita ātmanaḥ .tathā iti lakṣmaṇo vākyam rāmasya pratyapūjayat ..3-20-5..
rāghavo api mahat cāpam cāmīkara vibhūṣitam .cakāra sajyam dharmātmā tāni rakṣāṃsi ca abravīt ..3-20-6..
putrau daśarathasya āvām bhrātarau rāma lakṣmaṇau .praviṣṭau sītayā sārdham duścaram daṇḍakā vanam ..3-20-7..
phala mūla aśanau dāṃtau tāpasau dharma cāriṇau .vasantau daṇḍakāraṇye kim artham upahiṃsatha ..3-20-8..

bhaktāḥ caiva anuraktāḥ ca hitāḥ ca mama nityaśaḥ .hanyamānā api na hanyante na na kuryuḥ vaco mama ..3-21-3..

te tu rāmeṇa sāmarṣāḥ śūla paṭṭisa pāṇayaḥ .samare nihatāḥ sarve sāyakaiḥ marma bhedibhiḥ ..3-21-9..
tān bhūmau patitān dṛṣṭvā kṣaṇena eva mahājavān .rāmasya ca mahat karma mahān trāso abhavan mama ..3-21-10..

viṣāda nakra adhyuṣite paritrāsa ūrmi mālini .kim mām na trāyase magnām vipule śoka sāgare ..3-21-12..

mayi te yadi anukrośo yadi rakṣaḥsu teṣu ca .rāmeṇa yadi śaktiḥ te tejo vā asti niśā cara ..3-21-14..

tava caiva agrataḥ prāṇān tyakṣyāmi nirapatrapā .buddhyā aham anupaśyāmi na tvam rāmasya saṃyuge ..3-21-16..
sthātum prati mukhe śaktaḥ sa balo api mahā raṇe .śūramānī na śūraḥ tvam mithyā āropita vikramaḥ ..3-21-17..
apayāhi jana sthānāt tvaritaḥ saha bāndhavaḥ .jahi tvam samare mūḍhān yathā tu kulapāṃsana ..3-21-18..
mānuṣau tau na śaknoṣi hantum vai rāma lakṣmaṇau .niḥsattvasya alpa vīryasya vāsaḥ te kīdṛśaḥ tu iha ..3-21-19..

bhrātuḥ samīpe śoka ārtā naṣṭa saṃjñā babhūva ha .karābhyām udaram hatvā ruroda bhṛśa duḥkhitā ..3-21-22..
evam ādharṣitaḥ śūraḥ śūrpaṇakhyā kharaḥ tataḥ .uvāca rakṣasām madhye kharaḥ kharataram vacaḥ ..3-22-1..
tava apamāna prabhavaḥ krodho ayam atulo mama .na śakyate dhārayitum lavaṇa aṃbha iva ulbaṇam ..3-22-2..

bāṣpaḥ samdhāryatām eṣa saṃbhramaḥ ca vimucyatām .aham rāmam saha bhrātrā nayāmi yama sādanam ..3-22-4..

tayā paruṣitaḥ pūrvam punar eva praśaṃsitaḥ .abravīt dūṣaṇam nāma kharaḥ senā patim tadā ..3-22-7..
caturdaśa sahasrāṇi mama citta anuvartinām .rakṣasām bhīma vegānām samareṣu anivartinām ..3-22-8..

upasthāpaya me kṣipram ratham saumya dhanūṃṣi ca .śarān ca citrān khaḍgāṃ ca śaktī ca vividhāḥ śitāḥ ..3-22-10..

matsyaiḥ puṣpaiḥ drumaiḥ śailaiḥ candra sūryaiḥ ca kāṃcanaiḥ .māṃgalyaiḥ pakṣi samghaiḥ ca tārābhiḥ ca samāvṛtam ..3-22-14..
dhvaja nistriṃśa saṃpannam kiṃkiṇī vara bhūṣitam .sat aśva yuktam saḥ amarṣāt āruroha kharaḥ tadā ..3-22-15..

mudgaraiḥ paṭṭiśaiḥ śūlaiḥ sutīkṣṇaiḥ ca paraśvadhaiḥ .khaḍgaiḥ cakraiḥ ca hastasthaiḥ bhrājamānaiḥ sa tomaraiḥ ..3-22-18..
śaktibhiḥ parighaiḥ ghoraiḥ atimātraiḥ ca kārmukaiḥ .gadā asi musalaiḥ vajraiḥ gṛhītaiḥ bhīma darśanaiḥ ..3-22-19..
rākṣasānām sughorāṇām sahasrāṇi caturdaśa .niryātāni jana sthānāt khara citta anuvartinām ..3-22-20..

tataḥ tān śabalān aśvān tapta kāṃcana bhūṣitān .kharasya matam ājñāya sārathiḥ paryacodayat ..3-22-22..
saṃcodito rathaḥ śīghram kharasya ripu ghātinaḥ .śabdena āpūrayāmāsa diśaḥ sa pradiśaḥ tathā ..3-22-23..
pravṛddha manyuḥ tu kharaḥ khara svareripoḥ vadha artham tvarito yathā aṃtakaḥ .acūcudat sārathim unnadan punarmahābalo megha iva aśma varṣavān ..3-22-24..
tat prayātam balam ghoram aśivam śoṇita udakam .abhyavarṣat mahā meghaḥ tumulo gardabha aruṇaḥ ..3-23-1..
nipetuḥ turagāḥ tasya ratha yuktā mahājavāḥ .same puṣpacite deśe rājamārge yadṛcchayā ..3-23-2..

janasthāna samīpe ca samākramya khara svanāḥ .visvarān vividhān ca cakruḥ māṃsa ādā mṛga pakṣiṇaḥ ..3-23-5..

jāta kautūhalāt tatra vimānasthāḥ ca devatāḥ .dadṛśur vāhinīm teṣām rākṣasānām gata āyuṣām ..3-23-30..
rathena tu kharo vegāt sainyasya agrāt viniḥsṛtaḥ .śyenagāmī pṛthugrīvo yajñaśatruḥ vihaṃgamaḥ ..3-23-31..

tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāḥ ca saha cāraṇaiḥ .sameyuḥ ca mahātmano yuddha darśana kāṃkṣayā ..3-24-19..
ṛṣayaḥ ca mahātmano loke brahmarṣi sattamāḥ .sametya ca ūcuḥ sahitāḥ te anyonyam puṇya karmaṇaḥ ..3-24-20..
svasti go brāhmaṇānām ca lokānām ca iti saṃsthitāḥ .jayatām rāghavo yuddhe paulastyān rajanī carān ..3-24-21..
cakra hasto yathā yuddhe sarvān asura puṃgavān .evam uktvā punaḥ pra ūcuḥ ālokya ca parasparam ..3-24-22..
caturdaśa sahasrāṇi rakṣasām bhīma karmaṇām .ekaḥ ca rāmo dharmātmā katham yuddham bhaviṣyati ..3-24-23..

rūpam apratimam tasya rāmasya akliṣṭa karmaṇaḥ .babhūva rūpam kruddhasya rudrasya iva mahātmanaḥ ..3-24-26..
iti saṃbhāṣyamāṇo tu deva gaṃdharva cāraṇaiḥ .tato gaṃbhīra nirhrādam ghora carma āyudha dhvajam ..3-24-27..
anīkam yātudhānānām samantāt pratyadṛśyata .vīra ālāpān visṛjatām anyonyam abhigacchatām ..3-24-28..
cāpāni vispharayatām jṛṃbhatām ca api abhīkṣṇaśaḥ .vipraghuṣṭa svanānām ca duṃdubhīm ca api nighnatām ..3-24-29..
teṣām sutumulaḥ śabdaḥ pūrayāmāsa tad vanam .tena śabdena vitrastāḥ śvāpadā vana cāriṇaḥ ..3-24-30..
dudruvuḥ yatra niḥśabdam pṛṣṭhato na avalokayan .tat ca anīkam mahāvegam rāmam samanuvartata ..3-24-31..
ghṛta nānā praharaṇam gaṃbhīram sāgaropamam .rāmo api cārayan cakṣuḥ sarvato raṇa paṇḍitaḥ ..3-24-32..
dadarśa khara sainyam tat yuddha abhimukho gataḥ .vitatya ca dhanur bhīmam tūṇyāḥ ca uddhṛtya sāyakān ..3-24-33..
krodham āhārayat tīvram vadhārtham sarva rakṣasām .duṣprekṣyaścābhavatkruddhoyugāntāgnirivajvalan - yadvā -duṣprekṣyaḥ ca abhavat kruddho yugānta agniḥ iva jvalan ..3-24-34..
tam dṛṣṭvā tejasā āviṣṭam prāvyathan vana devatāḥ .tasya ruṣṭsya rūpam tu rāmasya dadṛśe tadā .dakṣasya iva kratum hantum udyatasya pinākinī ..3-24-35..
tat kārmukaiḥ ābharaṇaiḥ rathaiḥ catat varmābhiḥ ca agni samāna varṇaiḥ .babhūva sainyam piśita aśanināmsūrya udaye nīlam iva abhra jālam ..3-24-36..
avaṣṭabdha dhanum rāmam kruddham ca ripu ghātinam .dadarśa āśramam āgamya kharaḥ saha puraḥsaraiḥ ..3-25-1..
tam dṛṣṭvā saguṇam cāpam udyamya khara niḥsvanam .rāmasya abhimukham sūtam codyatām iti acodayat ..3-25-2..
sa kharasya ājñayā sūtaḥ turagān samacodayat .yatra rāmo mahābāhuḥ eko dhunvan dhanuḥ sthitaḥ ..3-25-3..
tam tu niṣpatitam dṛṣṭvā sarve te rajanī carāḥ .muṃcamānā mahānādam sacivāḥ paryavārayan ..3-25-4..
sa teṣām yātudhānānām madhye rathaḥ gataḥ kharaḥ .babhūva madhye tārāṇām lohitāṃga iva uditaḥ ..3-25-5..
tataḥ śara sahasrena rāmam apratima ojasam .ardayitvāa mahānādam nanāda samare kharaḥ ..3-25-6..
tataḥ tam bhīma dhanvānam kruddhāḥ sarve niśācarāḥ .rāmam nānā vidhaiḥ śastraiḥ abhyavarṣanta durjayam ..3-25-7..
mudgaraiḥ āyasaiḥ śūlaiḥ prāsaiḥ khaḍgaiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ .rākṣasāḥ samare rāmam nijaghnū roṣa tatparāḥ ..3-25-8..
te valāhaka saṃkāśā mahākāyā mahābalāḥ .abhyadhāvanta kākutstham rathaiḥ vājibhiḥ eva ca ..3-25-9..
gajaiḥ parvata kūṭa abhaiḥ rāmam yuddhe jiṃghāsavaḥ .te rāme śara varṣāṇi vyasṛjan rakṣasām gaṇāḥ ..3-25-10..
śailendram iva dhārābhir varṣamāṇā mahādhanāḥ .sarvaiḥ parivṛto rāmo rākṣasaiḥ kṝradarśinaiḥ ..3-25-11..
tithiṣu iva mahādevo vṛtaḥ pāriṣadām gaṇaiḥ .tāni muktāni śastrāṇi yātudhānaiḥ sa rāghavaḥ ..3-25-12..
pratijagrāha viśikhaiḥ nadi oghān iva sāgaraḥ .sa taiḥ praharaṇaiḥ ghoraiḥ bhinna gātro na vivyathe ..3-25-13..
rāmaḥ pradīptair bahubhir vajrair iva mahā acalaḥ .sa viddhaḥ kṣataja digdhaḥ sarva gātreṣu rāghavaḥ ..3-25-14..
babhūva rāmaḥ sandhya abhraiḥ divākara iva āvṛtaḥ .viṣedur deva gandharvāḥ siddhāḥ ca parama ṛṣayaḥ ..3-25-15..
ekam sahasraiḥ bahubhiḥ tadā dṛṣṭvā samāvṛtam .tato rāmaḥ tu susaṃkruddho maṇḍalī kṛta kārmukaḥ ..3-25-16..
sasarja niśitān bāṇān śataśaḥ atha sahasraśaḥ .duravārān durviṣahān kālapāśa upamān raṇe ..3-25-17..
mumoca līlayā rāmaḥ kaṃkapatrān kāṃcana bhūṣaṇān .te śarāḥ śatru sainyeṣu muktā rāmeṇa līlayā ..3-25-18..
ādadū rakṣasām prāṇān pāśāḥ kālakṛtā iva .bhittvā rākṣasa dehān tām te śarā rudhira āplutāḥ ..3-25-19..
aṃtarikṣa gatā rejuḥ dīpta agni sama tejasaḥ .asaṃkhyeyāḥ tu rāmasya sāyakāḥ cāpa maṇḍalāt ..3-25-20..
viniṣpetuḥ atīva ugrā rakṣaḥ prāṇa apahāriṇaḥ .taiḥ dhanūṃṣi dhvaja agrāṇi carmāṇi ca śirāṃsi ca ..3-25-21..
bahūn sa hasta ābharaṇān ūrūn kari kara upamān .cicheda rāmaḥ samare śataśaḥ atha sahasraśaḥ ..3-25-22..
hayān kāṃcana sannāhān ratha yuktān sa sārathīn .gajām ca sa gaja ārohān sa hayān sāradhinaḥ tadā ..3-25-23..
cichiduḥ bibhiduḥ ca eva rāma bāṇā guṇa cyutāḥ .padātīn samare hatvā hi anayat yama sadanam ..3-25-24..
tato nālīka nārācaiḥ tīkṣṇa agraiḥ vikarṇibhiḥ .bhīmam ārta svaram cakruḥ chidyamānā niśācarāḥ ..3-25-25..
tat sainyam niśitaiḥ bāṇaiḥ arditam marma bhedibhiḥ .na rāmeṇa  sukham lebhe śuṣkam vanam iva agninā ..3-25-26..
kecid bhīma balāḥ śūrāḥ prāsān śūlān paraśvadhān .cikṣipuḥ parama kruddhā rāmāya rajanīcarāḥ ..3-25-27..
teṣām bāṇaiḥ mahābāhuḥ śastrāṇi āvārya vīryavān .jahāra samare prāṇān ciccheda ca śiro dharān ..3-25-28..
te chinna śirasaḥ petuḥ chinna carma śarāsanāḥ .suparṇa vāta vikṣiptā jagatyām pādapā yathā ..3-25-29..
avaśiṣṭāḥ ca ye tatra viṣaṇṇāḥ te niśācarāḥ .kharam eva abhyadhāvanta śaraṇārtham śara āhatāḥ ..3-25-30..
tān sarvān dhanur ādāya samāśvāsya ca dūṣaṇaḥ .abhyadhāvata susaṃkruddhaḥ kruddhaḥ [rudram] kruddha iva antakaḥ ..3-25-31..
nivṛttāḥ tu punaḥ sarve dūṣaṇa āśraya nirbhayāḥ .rāmam eva abhyadhāvanta sāla tāla śila āyudhāḥ ..3-25-32..
śūla mudgara hastāḥ ca pāśa hastā mahābalāḥ .sṛjantaḥ śara varṣāṇi śastra varṣāṇi saṃyuge..3-25-33..
druma varṣāṇi muṃcantaḥ śilā varṣāṇi rākṣasāḥ .tad babhūva adbhutam yuddham tumulam roma harṣaṇam ..3-25-34..
rāmasya asya mahāghoram punaḥ teṣām ca rakṣasām .te samantāt abhikruddhā rāghavam punar ārdayan ..3-25-35..
tataḥ sarvā diśo dṛṣṭvā pradiśāḥ ca samāvṛtāḥ .rākṣasaiḥ sarvataḥ prāptaiḥ śara varṣābhiḥ āvṛtaḥ ..3-25-36..
sa kṛtvā bhairavam nādam astram parama bhāsvaram .samayojayat gāndharvam rākṣaseṣu mahābalaḥ ..3-25-37..
tataḥ śara sahasrāṇi niryayuḥ cāpa maṇḍalāt .sarvā daśa diśo bānaiḥ āpūryanta samāgataiḥ ..3-25-38..
na ādadānām śarān ghorān vimuṃcaṃtam śara uttamān .vikarṣamāṇam paśyanti rākṣasāḥ te śara ārditāḥ ..3-25-39..
śara andhakāram ākāśam āvṛṇot  sa divākaram .babhūva avasthito rāmaḥ prakṣipan iva tān śarān ..3-25-40..
yugapat patamānaiḥ ca yugapacca hataiḥ bhriśam .yugapat patitaiḥ caiva vikīrṇā vasudhā abhavat ..3-25-41..
nihatāḥ patitāḥ kṣīṇā cchinna bhinna vidāritāḥ .tatra tatra sma dṛśyante rākṣasāḥ te sahasraśaḥ ..3-25-42..
sa uṣṇīṣaiḥ uttama angaiḥ ca sa aṃgadaiḥ bāhubhiḥ tathā .ūrubhiḥ bāhubhiḥ cchinnaiḥ nānā rūpaiḥ vibhūṣaṇaiḥ ..3-25-43..
hayaiḥ ca dvipa mukhyaiḥ ca rathaiḥ bhinnaiḥ anekaśaḥ .cāmara vyajanaiḥ chatraiḥ dhvajaiḥ nānā vidhaiḥ api ..3-25-44..
rāmeṇa bāṇa abhihataiḥ vicchinnaiḥ śūla paṭṭiśaiḥ .khaḍgaiḥ khaṇḍīkṛtaiḥ prāsaiḥ vikīrṇaiḥ ca paśvadhaiḥ ..3-25-45..
cūṇitābhiḥ śilābhiḥ ca śaraiḥ citraiḥ anekaśaḥ .vicchinnaiḥ samare bhūmiḥ vistīrṇā ābhūt bhayaṃkarā ..3-25-46..
tān dṛṣṭvā nihatān sarve rakṣasāḥ parama āturāḥ .na tatra calitum śaktā rāmam para puraṃjayam ..3-25-47..
dūṣaṇaḥ tu svakam sainyam hanyamānam vilokya ca .saṃdideśa mahābāhuḥ bhīma vegān niśācarān ..3-26-1..
rākṣasān paṃca sāhasrān samareṣu anivartinaḥ .te śūlaiḥ paṭṭiśaiḥ kadagaiḥ śilā varaṣaiḥ drumaiḥ ..3-26-2..
śara varṣaiḥ vicchinnam vavarṣuḥ tam samantataḥ .tat drumāṇām śilānām ca varṣam prāṇa haram mahat ..3-26-3..
pratijagrāha dharmātmā rāghavaḥ tīkṣṇa sāyakaiḥ .pratigṛhya ca tad varṣam nimīlita iva ṛṣabhaḥ ..3-26-4..
rāmaḥ krodham param lebhe vadha artham sarva rakṣasām .tataḥ krodha samāviṣṭaḥ pradīpta iva tejasā ..3-26-5..
śaraiḥ abhyakirat sainyam sarvataḥ saha dūṣaṇam .tataḥ senā patiḥ kruddho dūṣaṇaḥ śatru dūṣaṇaḥ ..3-26-6..
śaraiḥ aśani kalpaiḥ tam rāghavam samavārayat .tato rāmaḥ saṃkruddhaḥ kṣureṇa asya mahat dhanuḥ ..3-26-7..
ciccheda samare vīraḥ caturbhiḥ caturo hayān .hatvā ca aśvān śaraiḥ tīkṣṇaiḥ artha candreṇa sārathe ..3-26-8..
śiro jahāra tad rakṣaḥ tribhir vivyādha vakṣasi .sa cchinna dhanvā viratho hata aśvo hata sārathiḥ ..3-26-9..
jagrāha giri śṛṃga ābham parigham roma harṣaṇam .veṣṭitam kāṃcanaiḥ paṭṭaiḥ deva sainya abhimardanam ..3-26-10..
āyasaiḥ śaṃkubhiḥ tīkṣṇaiḥ kīrṇam para vasā ukṣitām .vajra aśani sama sparśam para gopura dāraṇam ..3-26-11..
tam mahā uraga saṃkāśam pragṛhya parigham raṇe .dūṣaṇo abhyapatat rāmam krūra karmā niśācaraḥ ..3-26-12..
tasya abhipatamānasya dūṣaṇasya sa rāghavaḥ .dvābhyām śarābhyām ciccheda sa hasta ābharaṇau bhujau ..3-26-13..
bhraṣṭaḥ tasya mahākāyaḥ papāta raṇa mūrdhani .parighaḥ chinna hastasya śakra dhvaja iva agrataḥ ..3-26-14..
karābhyām ca vikīrṇābhyām papāta bhuvi dūṣaṇaḥ .viṣāṇābhyām viśīrṇābhyām manasvī iva mahāgajaḥ ..3-26-15..
dṛṣṭvā tam patitam bhūmau dūṣaṇam nihatam raṇe .sādhu sādhu iti kākutstham sarva bhūtāni apūjayan ..3-26-16..
